spec.name: Mother-of-Pearl Piano Accordion
spec.description: A full-size Italian piano accordion standing on small feet, its treble case and keyboard facing the viewer, with a pleated oxblood bellows inlaid with pearl lozenges and a stradella bass board on its left face, every surface trimmed in mother-of-pearl sheen panels and gold pinstripes.
spec.layout: Static display model, no joints, all geometry in model space. Front view (+Z): the piano keyboard runs across the top of the shallow treble case (white keys y 0.302..0.320, black keys proud above them, keycase with sloped lid up to y 0.445); below the keys the ornate grille with a pearl lozenge rosette; a nacre shelf under the keybed carries the deck. The bellows spine runs straight back: 13 oxblood fold cards with pearl lozenge inlays alternating with dark recessed pleats, ending at the bass box (z -0.155..-0.315) whose tall walnut bellows frame plates cap both ends. The bass button board sits on the left face (+X) with 4 diagonal rows of stradella buttons and a bass strap; the treble strap wraps the right face (-X). Both boxes rest on small rubber feet at y=0. Mother-of-pearl shows on every part: iridescent sheen built from alternating small tiles of nacre, blush, sea, sky, lilac and warm nacre, separated by inkPlum seams, edged with gold and goldLight pinstripes, with chrome corner caps and buckles as hardware accents.

spec.name: Madreperla Piano Accordion
spec.description: A 34-key Italian piano accordion lying on its back, in pearly celluloid (madreperla) with a black pleated bellows, a chrome and gold grille, and ruby and sapphire studs.
spec.layout: The accordion lies on its back with the long axis along Z, stored half-open. From the front (+Z) to the back (-Z): the piano keyboard facing +Z, the treble box (z 0.10..0.30, 0.46 wide, 0.26 tall), 14 black pleats of bellows (z 0.10 to -0.20, tapering from 0.43 to 0.37 wide, y 0.01..0.25), then the bass box (z -0.20..-0.30, 0.38 wide) with its bass-button board on the rear -Z end. The treble box and the bass box rest on y=0. The chrome and gold treble grille and the register switches sit on the treble top face, and the small bass grille sits on the bass top face. The bellows hang about 1 cm above the floor. Model right (-X) is the player's right hand; the register panel is on the +X end. STYLE: every pearl surface is a mosaic of thin 4-5 mm tiles in the pearl tints, seated on a pearlWhite base. Tile mix: 40% pearlWhite, 20% pearlCream, 15% pearlPink, 10% pearlBlue, 8% pearlMint, 7% pearlLilac, with 1 mm gaps showing pearlShade. All edges are bound in chrome rods. Corner caps and studs are gold, with ruby and sapphire gems. The bellows are glossy black with pearl corner tapes and gold ridge lines. The keys are ivory-white and black. Chrome is used for grilles, rails, button rims and buckles. Every part uses the same tile mix, the same chrome rod radius (0.0025) and the same gem sizes (radius 0.005 on cases, 0.008 on medallions). No joints; the model is static. To save part count, merge small same-colour pieces per part (mergeGeometries, with b.part at [0,0,0] and a bone-less root).

parts.builds: The right-hand (treble) box shell, 0.46 wide (x), 0.26 tall (y), 0.20 deep (z), as a pearlWhite base box with the mosaic of thin tiles in the shared tint mix on the top border (the frame around the grille zone), on both end faces (+X, -X), on the front wall z=0.30 beside and above and below the keyboard zone, and on the bottom plate. The bottom plate has a black leatherLight back panel with a chrome edge and four small chromeDark domed feet flush on y=0. The rear wall at z=0.10 is the plain pearlShade bellows mounting frame, a 0.43 x 0.24 opening outlined by a bellowsFold rim, for the bellows to meet. Chrome edge binding rods run along all 12 box edges. Gold corner caps (small chamfered cubes) sit on the 8 corners. A gem stud (ruby on the -X end face, sapphire on the +X end face, each in a goldBright ring) sits at the centre of each end face, with a pearlShade groove line around it. On the -X end face, a gold oval escutcheon plate carries a small engraved fleur motif made of goldDark strips. On the front wall, a 0.39 x 0.14 recessed keyboard window (y 0.06..0.20, x -0.195..0.195) is filled with a keyBlack felt slab at z 0.30, as backing for the keys. Do not build the grille, registers, keys or rails.
parts.attaches: Rests on the floor. Its rear face at z=0.10 meets the bellows at trebleBellowsFace. Its top face at y=0.26 carries trebleTop. Its front face at z=0.30 carries the keyboard at keyboardBed.

parts.builds: Everything on the treble top face (y 0.26..0.30, z 0.10..0.30). (1) The treble grille: a raised chrome frame plate, x -0.19..0.15 and z 0.12..0.28, over a grilleDark backing slab. Inside it, 11 slender chrome ribs fan out from the frame's -Z end and curl at their tips. Chrome scroll tendrils (spiral sweeps) fill the four corners. A central oval gold medallion at grilleCenter has a goldDark rim, a ruby gem in the middle (radius 0.008) and four small sapphire gems around it, with goldBright filigree dots. A goldBright border line and gold rivets run round the frame. (2) The register panel at x 0.175..0.225, z 0.12..0.28: a pearlCream strip with a chrome edge, carrying 6 rocker switches in a row along z. Each switch has a chrome base, a keyWhite rocker that is tilted slightly, and a tiny keyBlack dot, plus a gold nameplate. (3) A small gold plaque reading as the maker's brand, with 5 keyBlack dashes as letters, and a pearlPink and pearlBlue marquetry flower of 5 petals next to the grille at x=-0.21 as accent. All items stay within y<=0.30 and sit seated on the case top at y=0.26.
parts.attaches: Sits on trebleCase's top face (caseTopY, y=0.26). The grille is centred at grilleCenter. The register panel is at registerPanel.

parts.builds: The piano keyboard on the front wall of the treble box, facing +Z. 21 ivory keyWhite keys, each 0.0176 wide (x), 0.14 long (y, from 0.06 to 0.20), 0.016 deep (z, z 0.30..0.316), on a 0.0186 pitch from x=-0.195 to 0.195, with a 0.0010 gap between them (keyEdge slim lines on the front lip). 15 keyBlack keys, 0.011 wide, 0.075 long (y 0.125..0.20), z 0.30..0.328, centred on the boundary after white keys 0,1,2,4,5 of each 7-key octave (the sequence starts at F). A chrome lower key rail (y 0.035..0.06, z 0.30..0.325) with a feltRed felt strip on its upper face, and an upper rail (y 0.20..0.235) that is pearlCream with a chrome edge and carries a gold nameplate at the centre (x -0.05..0.05) with goldDark engraved dashes. The key cheeks, at x ±0.195..±0.23 and y 0.04..0.23, are pearlCream blocks with small gold rivets and a sapphire stud at each top. Highlight: a very thin keyWhite shine strip on every black key's top.
parts.attaches: Sits on the front wall of trebleCase at keyboardBed (z=0.30). The rails align to keyRailLow and keyRailHigh. It touches nothing else.

parts.builds: The pleated bellows between the boxes, from z=0.10 (trebleBellowsFace, 0.43 wide x 0.24 tall) to z=-0.20 (bassBellowsFace, 0.37 wide x 0.24 tall, y 0.01..0.25). It has 14 pleats of pitch 0.0214 in z. Each pleat has an outer peak ring (dimensions interpolated between the front and rear sizes, +0.012 on width and height) and an inner valley ring (-0.014 on width and height), joined by sloping bellowsBlack slabs on all 4 sides (top, bottom, +X, -X). The valley slabs alternate with bellowsFold for a glossy shaded look. A thin feltRed liner band sits in each valley groove. At the 4 corners of each peak, a pearlWhite corner tape (small angled strip) forms a continuous zig-zag along each corner edge, with a goldBright stud at each peak corner. A thin gold line runs along the middle of every other peak ridge on the top and bottom faces. The front and rear end pleats are capped with a chrome-bound bellowsFold frame plate 0.004 thick. A chrome-and-leather bellows latch strap hangs at the +X side near z=-0.15, with chrome buckle.
parts.attaches: Its front end meets trebleCase's rear face at trebleBellowsFace, and its rear end meets bassBox's front face at bassBellowsFace. It does not touch the floor.

parts.builds: The left-hand (bass) box, 0.38 wide (x), 0.26 tall (y), 0.10 deep (z, z -0.20..-0.30). It is a pearlWhite shell with the same pearl tile mosaic (shared tint mix) on its top border, both sides (+X, -X), the bottom and the front wall, with chrome edge binding and 8 gold corner caps, plus a ruby stud on each side face in a goldBright ring. Its front wall at z=-0.20 is a pearlShade bellows mounting frame with a bellowsFold rim, 0.37 x 0.24 opening at bassBellowsFace. The rear wall, z=-0.30, is a bass-button board: a chrome-bound black keyBlack board (x -0.14..0.14, y 0.035..0.225) with a grid of 6 columns by 8 rows of round buttons (radius 0.0085, protruding to z=-0.315), alternately keyWhite and keyBlack by row, each in a thin chrome rim, the buttons in the middle row marked with a gold dimple. The board's rail strips are pearlCream with gold rivets. On the top face (y=0.26) there is a small bass grille, 0.16 x 0.07: a chrome frame, grilleDark backing, 7 chrome slats and a gold medallion (radius 0.012) with one sapphire gem, up to y=0.285. On the bottom there is a black leather back plate with 3 chromeDark feet on y=0. A leather bass strap (leather, with leatherLight stitch lines and a chrome buckle) loops over the bass-box side at +X (x up to 0.20) at bassStrapAnchor.
parts.attaches: Rests on the floor. Its front face at z=-0.20 meets the bellows at bassBellowsFace. The bass strap hangs from bassStrapAnchor.

spec.name: Alebrije Jaguar-Eagle
spec.description: An Oaxacan alebrije chimera: a muscular spotted jaguar standing proud with a feathered eagle head, hooked beak, wide spread painted wings and a plumed tail.
spec.layout: The creature stands like a heraldic jaguar, facing +Z, chest out, on four legs whose feet rest on y = 0 (legs are the only floor part). The torso runs along z from about z = -0.9 (rump) to z = +0.8 (chest), centred on x = 0, belly line around y = 0.7, back line around y = 1.35, with a muscular deep chest and tucked waist. The neck rises from the chest front at z = 0.72 up to the eagle head at z = 1.15, y = 1.5, facing forward: the eagle head has a hooked yellow beak, a tall feather crest, huge painted eyes and a slightly open jaw with visible teeth. Two wide eagle wings spread from the shoulders up and outward, tips at x = ±1.3, y = 2.3, fully feathered with layered primaries in teal and yellow and covert rows in magenta and cream. The tail sweeps back and up from the rump in a lazy S to z = -2.2, ending in a fan of feather plumes. Every part is alebrije style: bold blocky primitive shapes, burnt-orange coat, hand-painted-looking flat colours, rosette spots, zigzag and stripe trim bands in teal, magenta, yellow and green, and crisp ink outlines on edges, eyes and beak. Nothing else is on the floor: no base, no scenery, the animal is the whole model.

Use a loft or sweep with shift so the belly hangs slightly below the spine line. Surfaces: burnt-orange coat (coat) with darker orange (coatShade) shading low on the flanks and belly, cream belly and chest bib separated from the orange by a zigzag fur edge or a scalloped trim band in teal with an ink outline. Rosette spots: jaguar rosettes as small ring-like parts (tiny torus or ring segments, tealDark with a coat-coloured centre) scattered on the upper flanks, shoulders and haunches, denser on the back, none on the cream belly; about 18-24 rosettes. Signature alebrije trim: a narrow painted saddle band across the back at z = 0.15 made of layered magenta, yellow and teal stripes with an ink edge, plus small geometric eye-dots (concentric white/teal/magenta discs) on each flank hip. A dorsal mane ridge: a row of 7-9 short triangular feather fins (extrude slabs, alternating teal and magenta with ink rims) seated along the spine from z = 0.4 back to z = -0.5, increasing in size toward the shoulders. spec.name: Alebrije Jaguar-Eagle
spec.description: A Oaxacan alebrije of carved painted wood: a jaguar's body and legs with an eagle's hooked-beak head, crest and spread wings, covered in dot-flower, zigzag and rosette patterns in bright enamel colours.
spec.layout: Rest pose, standing on four paws, facing +Z. The body is a chunky jaguar about 1.9 m long (z -1.0..+0.9), belly at y~0.62 and back at y~1.35. Four sturdy, slightly short jaguar legs with big round paws stand on y=0. Front legs sit at x=±0.30, z~0.6, and hind legs at x=±0.32, z~-0.7 (knee forward, hock back, toe forward). A thick neck rises from the chest forward and up into a big, bold eagle head at about (0,1.6,1.2). The head has an oversized hooked golden beak (upper and lower jaw separate, tip at about z=1.78, y=1.45) and large round eyes with thick dark rims, one on each side. A tall crest of broad feather blades fans up and back from the crown (top y~2.0), with a ruff of overlapping feathers round the neck. The wings are spread wide, almost level, rising slightly to the tips: x out to ±1.85, y 1.2..1.7. Each has a short blocky arm section, covert rows, then layered long flight feathers trailing back (-z) and fanning out to the tip. A long jaguar tail leaves the rump at (0,0.97,-0.95), runs back and sags, then curls up to y~1.3 at z~-1.95 and ends in a fan of 5-7 painted feathers reaching z~-2.25. The look is Oaxacan painted wood: simple chunky carved base shapes, faceted and low-poly, with every surface a flat enamel colour. Detail is made only from small parts seated on the surface: rows of dots, dot-flowers (centre dot, ring of 5-6 petal dots, dark outline disc beneath), jaguar rosettes (dark ring with a coloured centre), zigzag bands, tiny diamonds, spirals and stripes. Every large form gets a contrasting outline colour, a main colour and a fine highlight. All parts share one motif vocabulary: white and yellow dot rows along every edge, magenta, turquoise and cobalt accents against the orange jaguar base, and black outlines. Colour is warm on top and cooler underneath. No ground, base or props.

parts.builds: Torso and neck. The torso is one smooth-skinned loft along hips->spine1->chest, using bone: [hips, spine1, chest]. It runs from the rump at z -1.0 (half-width 0.30, half-height 0.27) to the chest at z +0.85 (half-width 0.38, half-height 0.38), centred around y 0.95-1.05, with belly at y~0.62 and back at y~1.35. Chest and belly are bellyCream, back and flanks jaguarOrange (sectors or bands). A thick neck sweep (bone: [chest, neck1, neck2]) runs from the chest (0,1.08,0.75) through neck1 and neck2 up to the neckTop (0,1.5,1.08), radius 0.27 tapering to 0.22, in jaguarOrange with a cream throat. The head part's ruff covers its end. Painted detail, all as small parts seated on the surface with stick, ring and along: jaguar rosettes (dark ink ring with a magenta, turquoise or yellow centre, 40-60 of them scattered over back and flanks with a minimum spacing); a dorsal stripe of alternating cobalt and magenta diamonds along the spine; rows of white dots round the girth; a zigzag band (turquoise and ink triangles) along each flank; dot-flowers on the shoulders and haunches; a chest bib of 12-16 overlapping rounded feather scales, in rows going lilac/pink/turquoise, on the front of the chest and base of the neck; hip and shoulder 'tattoo' swirls in ink with dot rows. The torso hides the leg-hip sockets and wing roots inside its volume.
parts.attaches: Wings attach at the wingRootL/R mounts (inside the shoulders). Legs attach at hipFL/FR/HL/HR. The tail starts at tailRoot. The neck ends at neckTop, where the head sits. Rides joints hips, spine1, chest, neck1, neck2.

parts.builds: The eagle head, centred on the headCenter mount, built big and bold (head scale about 1.2). The skull is a chunky faceted ellipsoid in jaguarYellow. A cream-and-orange cheek and brow mask surrounds the eyes with a feather pattern. Eyes: two big eyes at x=±0.2, y~1.72, z~1.3 facing sideways and forward, each stacked from an ink disc, a white ring, an eyeGlow iris, an ink pupil and a tiny white highlight, with a thick ink brow ridge above that has three small dots. The beak is built as a separate upper and lower jaw. The upper beak (rides head) is a hooked wedge of beakGold, wide at the base (z 1.35), running forward and curving down to a sharp point at beakTip (0,1.45,1.78), with ink nostril dots, a beakDark ridge line and turquoise/magenta stripe bands. The lower beak (rides jaw) is shorter and lighter, ending around z 1.65, with a red tongue and a cream edge strip inside. A cere of pink and white dots sits at the beak base. The crest is 7-9 broad leaf-shaped feather blades (extrude) fanning up and back from crestRoot (0,1.9,1.05), tallest in the middle (top y~2.0, tilted back), colours cycling magenta, turquoise, cobalt, lime and yellow, with an ink outline blade behind each one, white dot rows on each, and small round tip dots. A neck ruff of 2 rings x 10 overlapping pointed feathers (turquoise, cobalt, pink, white tips) wraps the neck at z 0.95-1.1, around the neckTop mount, leaning back and out. Ear-tuft feathers sit on each side of the crest. Small yellow/white dot garlands run along the beak sides, brows and cheeks.
parts.attaches: Sits on the neck end at neckTop (0,1.5,1.08). The upper beak and skull ride joint head, the lower jaw rides joint jaw (hinge at jawHinge). Nothing hangs in front of the face.

parts.builds: Two spread wings, mirrored (left is +x), each riding wingRoot, wingElbow, wingWrist and wingTip. Each has a chunky arm section (a swept tube of jaguarOrange with rosettes, radius 0.16 tapering to 0.08) from wingRoot through wingElbow and wingWrist to wingTip, with bone: those joints. Behind and under it come feather layers, built as extruded rounded leaf shapes that lie nearly flat and fan out: (1) lesser coverts: 2 rows of short wide feathers along the arm's trailing edge (cobalt, turquoise, magenta); (2) greater coverts: 8-10 medium feathers; (3) 8-9 secondary flight feathers trailing back from the elbow and arm, 0.55-0.75 long, and 7-9 long primaries 0.8-1.0 long fanning back and outward from wrist and tip, with the longest at the tip. Flight feather colours in sequence: magenta, orange, yellow, lime, turquoise, cobalt, purple, each with an ink outline feather slightly larger behind it, a central quill line in white, a row of white dots down the vane, and a contrasting tip band or zigzag. Each feather rides the nearest wing joint. Leading edge: a row of white dots along the front of the arm and a turquoise/ink zigzag band at the wrist. Shoulder cover: a dot-flower of 6 petal dots at each wing root. Wing planes rise gently toward the tips (tip y~1.55) and the feathers droop slightly (a few degrees). Wingspan is ±1.85 in x including feather tips. The wing must clearly clear the torso: the feather trailing edges lie at z -0.2..-1.2.
parts.attaches: Roots at wingRootL/R (±0.32,1.22,0.4), hidden in the shoulders of the body part. Rides wingRoot/Elbow/Wrist/Tip L and R.

parts.builds: Four jaguar legs, mirrored (left is +x), riding hip/knee/ankle/toe F and H, L and R. Front legs: thick swept tubes (radius 0.14 at the top, 0.09 at the wrist) in jaguarOrange with a bellyCream inner side, running hip (y 0.88) -> knee (0.5) -> ankle (0.2) -> toe, ending in big round paws. Hind legs: a heavy thigh (a flattened ellipsoid or loft, radius 0.2) tapering into a bent leg, with the knee forward and the hock back, then a long foot to the toe. Paws are chunky rounded shapes sitting flat on y=0 (lowest points touch the floor), about 0.2 wide and 0.3 long, in jaguarYellow with a cream underside. Each paw has 4 toe bumps in front (spheres) and a gold-white curved claw per toe (small cones, claw colour). Painted detail: ink rosette rings and spots on thighs and shoulders; 2-3 stripes of cobalt/magenta bands (cuffs) with white dot rows round each leg above the paw; a dot-flower on the outer side of each thigh and shoulder; zigzag bands of turquoise and ink on the ankle; a pink pad dot under each paw; a small tuft of 3 pointed feathers at each hock and wrist in turquoise/magenta/white, pointing back.
parts.attaches: Start at the hip mounts hipFL/FR/HL/HR (hidden in the torso). All paw soles rest at y=0. Rides all hip/knee/ankle/toe joints.

parts.builds: A long, thick jaguar tail (a swept tube over tail1..tail4, with bone: [tail1, tail2, tail3, tail4], tapering radius 0.15 -> 0.07) from tailRoot (0,0.97,-0.95) back via (0,0.92,-1.35) and (0,0.95,-1.7), curling up to (0,1.3,-1.95). It is jaguarOrange, with bands (alternating ink and cobalt/magenta rings, one ring per 0.15 m) and a cream underside. Rows of white dots follow the top and the sides, there are a few rosettes at the base, and a dot-flower where it joins the rump. At the end, riding tail4, sits a fan of 5-7 big feathers (extruded leaf blades 0.5-0.7 long) spreading up and back like a peacock plume, the middle one tallest: tipped at z about -2.2 and y up to 1.75, in magenta, turquoise, cobalt, lime, yellow and purple, each with an ink outline feather behind it, a white quill line, rows of dots and a round 'eye' tip (ink disc, white ring, coloured centre). Add a small ruff of 6 short feathers wrapping the tail where the fan meets it. Add a feathered rump-flame crest: 5 small pointed feathers (pink, yellow, orange) along the top of the rump just forward of the tail root at z -0.9..-0.75, y~1.3.
parts.attaches: Starts at the tailRoot mount (0,0.97,-0.95), in the rump of the body part. Rides tail1..tail4.

spec.layout: Stands on four legs facing +Z, centred on x=0. Front to back: a hooked yellow eagle beak at z=+1.5, the head (centre z~0.95, y~1.4) on a thick S-curved neck rising from the chest (y~1.0, z~0.7), then a chunky jaguar torso (z -0.85..+0.85, centre y~0.88, belly y~0.55, back y~1.2) on short sturdy legs, then a tail curving back and upward ending in a fan of feather-flames at z~-2.0. The front legs are jaguar legs with big round paws. The hind legs have a fat feathered thigh over a bird-like hock and an eagle foot with 3 forward talons and 1 rear talon. The wings spread out from the shoulders (y~1.1) to x=+-1.7 in a display rest pose, raised a little (wrist y~1.45) with the feathers trailing backward (-Z) and fanning, the longest primaries at the tips. Proportions are chunky and toy-like: big head, thick neck, heavy shoulders, short legs, huge wings. Style: Oaxacan painted wood. Every surface is a flat bright colour broken up by small repeated parts: rows of white dots along every edge, rosette flowers (dark ring, coloured petals, gold centre dot), zigzag greca bands, leaf-and-vine scrolls, and stripes. Faceted low-poly forms with a slightly carved look. All motifs are small parts seated on the surfaces. Colours never blend; each stripe or dot is its own colour. Unpainted raw wood shows only at the toe tips and the horn-like beak ridge.

parts.builds: The jaguar torso as one loft over the hips, spine1, spine2 and chest joints (smooth skin), z -0.85..+0.85, about 0.62 wide at the chest and hips and a bit narrower at the waist, 0.55..0.7 tall, deep chest and a rounded rump. Colouring: jaguarOrange back, a cream belly band along the underside (use sectors or a separate belly loft), and a marigold stripe low on the flanks. Jaguar markings as small parts seated on the surface with surface.scatter or along: about 30 rosettes (a ring of 5 small indigo spheres or flat discs around a gold or magenta centre dot) over the back and flanks, plus single indigo spots on the haunches. Painted-wood folk decoration: a magenta saddle strip down the spine with a turquoise zigzag (greca) band set into it made from small wedge parts and a row of white dots on each side; 2 large flower motifs, one on each flank (8 petals in pink, magenta, sky and cobalt around a gold centre, with a white dot ring), and smaller flowers on the shoulder and haunch; rows of tiny cream and white dots along the belly line and chest; a chest bib of cream with red and turquoise triangle points; a necklace-like band of alternating coloured beads around the chest base where the neck sprouts; a small raised ridge of leaf shapes along the backbone in leaf and lime green. Also builds the shoulder and haunch masses (large flattened spheres at x +-0.3 on the shoulders at z~0.5 and at the hips at z~-0.5, y~0.8) in jaguarOrange with indigo dot rings, so the legs read as growing out of them. Hip and shoulder masses stay inside x +-0.45.
parts.attaches: Skinned to hips, spine1, spine2 and chest. The neck sprouts at the neckBase mount (inside the chest), the wings root at wingRootL/R (just above the shoulders, covered by a flower rosette boss on each side), the tail begins at tailRoot, the legs start at the shoulder and hip mounts inside the shoulder and haunch masses.

parts.builds: The eagle head and neck. Neck: a thick tube along neck1 and neck2 from neckBase (radius ~0.2 at the base, ~0.15 at the head), cream front and jaguarOrange back sectors, with a ruff collar of 14-18 overlapping feather blades (extrude or slab) ringed around the neck base in marigold, magenta, turquoise, cobalt rotating colours, each with a white dot, and rows of small dots up the neck. Head: a strong faceted skull (about 0.34 wide, 0.32 tall, 0.4 long) centred at headCentre in jaguarOrange with a cream face mask and a turquoise brow band. Eyes: big round forward-and-sideways facing eyes at x +-0.15 on the front of the skull (y~1.47, z~1.05): black outline disc, gold iris disc, indigo pupil, tiny white highlight, a brow ridge of heavy indigo wedge above each eye with 3 small dots, and an eyeliner swirl tail in magenta. Jaguar ears: two round ears on the top-outer skull (x +-0.15, y~1.62, z~0.88) in jaguarOrange with an indigo rim and a cream inner disc. Crest: a fan of about 9 tall feather blades rising from the crown between the ears (y 1.6..1.9, tilted backward and fanned sideways) in a rainbow of red, marigold, lime, turquoise, cobalt, violet and magenta with white tips and dot centrelines. Cheek ruffs: 3 layers of short feather blades under each cheek, and a swirl-and-dots pattern on each cheek in turquoise, white and magenta. The highest point of the model is the crest tip, y~1.9.

Category: Plant.

spec.name: Pandoran Glowspire
spec.description: A tall bioluminescent alien plant: a dark indigo spiral-veined stalk rising from a root mound into a crown of glowing fronds, ringed by three huge unfurling helicoradian coils and clusters of lit ground pods.
spec.layout: Front (+Z) view: a low root mound 0.4 m tall fills the footprint, its rim carrying buttress roots, moss, glowing mushroom clusters and lit ground pods. From the mound centre a single dark indigo stalk rises with a gentle forward-then-back lean to 2.3 m, wrapped in glowing vertebra rings at each spine joint. At the crown hub the stalk opens into a fan of 8-10 broad teal fronds that arc out and down to a 2.0 m spread, every frond edged and veined in bright cyan light, with glowing spore pods hanging beneath them. Three helicoradian coils anchor to the mound ring: one front-left, one back-right, one front-right, each a thin stem curling into a huge spiralled frond sheet up to 1.5 m tall, its rim glowing pink-cyan. All silhouettes are bold low-poly curves; every light line, vein and pod is its own small glowing part against the dark flora colours.

parts.builds: The ground piece: a smooth lathe or lofted mound of dark soil (soil) rising from y=0 to about 0.35 m at the centre and thinning to a lip at radius ~0.9 m, with 5-7 buttress roots in rootPlum flaring out of the mound sides like low fins, each tipped with a tiny glowCyan stud. Moss patches (moss) as flat painted blotches or thin slabs on upward faces. Two features cluster on the mound: a group of 5 glowing mushrooms (capViolet domes on short stems, gillCyan undersides and stem rings, all glow kit lit) near the front-left, and a cluster of 3 teardrop ground pods in rootPlum with vertical glowPink slit lights and glowCyan rim rims near the front-right. Scatter small glowCyan pebble-lights over the soil. The stalk passes through the mound centre; leave a collar of dark bark there so stalkFoot reads as planted. This part owns joints base, coilA, coilB, coilC.
parts.attaches: Owns the floor (floor: true). Its top centre is the stalkFoot mount where the stalk emerges; its mound surface at the three coilAnchor points is where the coils root.

parts.builds: The main trunk: one sweep along the base-stalk1-stalk2-stalk3-crown chain, radius tapering from ~0.11 m at the foot to ~0.05 m under the crown, catmull through the joint positions so the lean reads. Bark in bark with a subtle two-tone mottle or gradient toward barkLight on up-facing sides; section circle with modest sides for a faceted look. Signature detail: at each spine joint, a glowing vertebra ring in glowCyan (a thin band or ring of small studs seated on the bark via surface loop/along), and 2-3 rows of small blister studs in barkLight climbing the trunk between rings. Near the foot, two short bark thorn frustumBoxes or spikes lean against the trunk. Add 3-4 tiny glowBlue lichen dots scattered up the shaded side. The crown joint tops out at the crownHub mount; cap the sweep with a small bud in frondDark so the canopy sits on it.
parts.attaches: Emerges from rootMound at the stalkFoot mount (its buried foot continues into the mound); its top ends at the crownHub mount where canopy attaches.

parts.builds: The glowing crown: around the crownHub mount, a ring of 8-10 fronds built as b.ring frames about the crown line, each frond an extruded leaf shape (smooth 2, thickness tapering 0.02 to 0.004) curving outward and down like an umbrella, sized 0.5-0.8 m. Frond bodies in frondDark with the outer third fading to frondMid via gradient; every frond carries 3-5 thin vein slabs or rod lines in glowCyan running root to tip, plus a glowCyan rim edge, all glow-lit. Between fronds, the central bud at the hub: a small lathe dome in frondMid with a glowViolet tip light. Beneath the fronds hang 6-8 spore pods on thin stalk rods: small lathe or capsule pods in sporeGold and glowPink, alternating, each glowing softly, dangling at varied lengths 0.15-0.3 m. Group the fronds under 3-4 fan group joints created with b.ring joints option so they can be posed together.
parts.attaches: Roots entirely at the crownHub mount on top of the stalk; hanging pods stay above rootMound's box and clear of the coils.

parts.builds: Three helicoradian spirals, one per coilAnchor mount, each riding its coil joint: a thin stem rod (stemCoil, radius ~0.02) rising from the anchor and curling over via a catmull or spiral path up to 1.2-1.5 m, then a huge unfurling frond sheet built as a membrane or lofted ribbon following a spiral that tightens toward the tip, in frondDark with the curl edge in frondMid. Each coil's outer rim carries a continuous glowPink edge line (a thin swept band along the rim) and 4-6 glowCyan vein rods across the sheet, glow-lit. Vary the three coils: coilA tallest and leaning right-forward, coilB shorter and curled tighter, coilC mid-height unfurling toward the front so the trio reads as a family, not copies. Each stem base gets a small mound collar and 2 root fins in rootPlum to seat it on the mound. Keep the inner volumes clear of the stalk box.
parts.attaches: Each coil stems from its named coilAnchor mount on the rootMound surface, geometry riding its coilA/coilB/coilC joint; tips stay inside the box, below the canopy.

calls.reasoning:
I need to write a spec JSON for a bioluminescent alien plant in Avatar (Pandora) style. 3-6 parts splitting work evenly. Avatar style: bioluminescent flora, glowing cyan/blue/purple spiral shapes, helicoradian-like spiral plants, glowing tendrils, dark teal foliage, magenta/cyan glow.

Think of a composition: a hero plant — a large bioluminescent stalk/tree with a curling canopy of glowing fronds, plus spiral helicoradian-like coils, glowing ground pods/mushrooms at base, and floating spore pods. Central stalk with fronds, side tendrils.

Parts (4):
1. rootBase: root mound, ground bulbs, glowing mushrooms/pods at base (floor: true).
2. trunkStalk: main stalk chains with glowing spine rings.
3. canopyFronds: glowing fronds/leaves at top of stalk.
4. sideTendrils: spiral helicoradian coils and vine tendrils around the base.

Maybe 5 parts: add floating spore pods. Keep 4-5.

Size: height ~2.4 m plant, width ~2.0, depth ~2.0. Let's say [2.2, 2.6, 2.0]. Center on x=0. Base at y=0.

Joints: a static model could have joints for animation — bioluminescent plant could sway. Provide joints: root, stalk1-3 (spine), frond branches (fan), coil stems (hinge/spiral). Keep skeleton modest: root "base", chain joints for stalk: stalk1, stalk2, stalk3, head. Fronds ring group joints. Coils each a joint.

Define joints in order parents first:
- base at [0, 0.15, 0], dir [0,1,0], role spine, no parent (root)
- stalk1 parent base at [0,0.5,0.05], dir [0,1,0.15], role spine
- stalk2 parent stalk1 at [0,1.1,0.18], dir [0,1,0.1], role spine
- stalk3 parent stalk2 at [0,1.7,0.28], dir [0,1,-0.05], role spine
- crown parent stalk3 at [0,2.2,0.22], dir [0,1,-0.1], role neck (or spine)
- frondRing: role fan joints? Ring joints created by builders though — spec says joints list created before parts run; ring group joints can be created by parts via b.ring with joints option. But spec's joints array lists skeleton. I can list a few fan joints: frondA..frondF parent crown. Let ring builder create them? Simpler: list them in joints array so order is fixed.

Let me define: crown at [0,2.2,0.22]; frond joints f1..f8? That's many. Maybe 6 frond joints with role fan, group fronds. Two full-height side panels run from floor to crown, deep purple with vinyl side art; the back panel closes the rear. Every visible edge wears bright T-molding trim, and neon edge strips run up both outer front corners with a glowing underglow strip beneath the kick base. spec.name: Neon Horizon — 1980s Arcade Cabinet
spec.description: A 1980s upright arcade cabinet rendered in synthwave: a black-and-purple shell with chrome trim, a glowing sunset marquee, a CRT alive with a neon grid and striped sun, and a deck of glowing buttons and a magenta ball-top joystick.

The middle holds the screen recess: the cabinet front face leans back about 12° and the CRT sits inside it, glass facing up-forward, surrounded by a black bezel with chrome edge. Above the screen, the cabinet top sweeps back and the marquee header (y 1.5–1.8) tilts forward over the player, showing a glowing title sign over sunset stripes, with two backlit speaker grilles below it. The sides are tall flat panels with the classic swooping arcade profile, edged with chrome T-molding and a thin cyan neon tube tracing the silhouette; the back panel is plain dark with a vent grille. Style on every part: flat black/purple faces, chrome fittings, and self-lit neon — cyan grid, magenta horizon, sunset sun on the screen, glowing marquee letters, backlit speaker slits, lit coin slots, a magenta ball top, and a cyan underglow line where the cabinet meets the floor.

parts.builds: The upper cabinet (y 0.9–1.8) and marquee. A top panel and plain back panel (cordBlack) with a small steel vent grille close the box; the shell's lower front face spans the deck ledge at deckRoot. The screen recess is a lean-back opening framed with a black bezel lip that meets the screen assembly around screenWell (the recess opening is the shell's job). Above it, the marquee header tilts forward: a cabinetPurple frame holding a glowing sign panel — a dark glass slab with sunsetGold, sunsetOrange and sunsetPink horizontal stripe bands behind, and the title 'NEON RIDER' built as thin extruded neon tube letters, N-E-O-N in neonCyan and RIDER in neonMagenta, all glowing. parts.attaches: Sits on the base at the waistSeam mount (matching side profiles, a neonMagenta trim seam at y 0.9 built by both), frames the screen recess around screenWell, and offers the deck ledge at deckRoot.

parts.builds: The CRT assembly seated in the shell's recess at screenWell, glass tilted back about 12° facing up and forward. Under the glass on the bezel's lower ledge: a small chrome brand plate and a single glowing neonCyan power LED dot, plus a cordBlack cable stub dropping from the lower back corner.
parts.attaches: Fills the shell's screen recess around the screenWell mount; its bezel lip meets the shell's recess frame.

parts.builds: The control deck: a slanted panel (rising ~8° toward the player) in deckDark with a chrome edge trim around its perimeter and a neonCyan glow strip along the forward lip. Right station: two rows of three pushbuttons (buttonWhite, buttonRed, sunsetGold caps) each seated in a dark bezel ring with a chrome rim; the centre bottom button of the inner row on each side. Between the stations a start panel: a small cabinetBlack recess with two small round start buttons in neonCyan and neonMagenta, both glowing, above a tiny glowWhite 'CREDIT 1' strip decal and a glowing neonViolet coin-credit counter slit. spec.name: Frostline Station 9
spec.description: A Firewatch-style arctic research outpost diorama: a red-roofed timber cabin with glowing windows on a snow-cut platform, a tall guyed radio mast with a lit beacon, a storage shed, and scattered crates, barrels, a sled and a snowmobile, all flat-coloured with bold warm-and-cold contrasts.
spec.layout: The diorama reads as a warm island in a cold field. A snow platform covers the whole footprint with sculpted drifts, a darker packed-snow path running front (+Z) to back, and exposed rock chunks at the edges; a plank deck is raised on the platform at its centre-left. The main cabin (centre-left, roughly x -1.2..0.6, z -0.8..0.9) stands on the deck: dark timber walls, a steep Firewatch orange-red gabled roof, yellow trim boards, a teal door, a stone chimney with a pale smoke wisp of cards, and warm glowing windows set in dark frames. A tall lattice radio mast rises at the right rear (x ~1.35, z ~-1.7) to y 4.6: steel-dark legs, a radar dish aimed up-forward, cross-braces, guy ropes and a red glowing beacon at the tip. Left rear sits a small timber storage shed (x -1.6..-0.7, z -2.2..-1.1) with the same roof colour and a tilted weather-vane pole. The front strip (z 0.7..2.5) holds the props: a wood sled with steel runners, a stack of crates, a ring of red fuel drums, a compact snowmobile in teal with steel skis, and a row of fence posts with a windsock on a pole at the far front-right. Style: every surface one flat colour, chunky readable silhouettes, warm oranges and yellows on cabin, roof, door glow and drums against cool blue-white snow and grey-blue steel, small parts (trim, bands, frames, flags) as their own flat-coloured pieces seated on the surfaces.

parts.builds: The snow platform the whole station stands on: a big low chunky snow slab (rounded box/loft silhouette) from x -1.9..1.9, z -2.8..2.6, top y ~0.35-0.5, standing on y=0. Cut a darker packed-snow path strip running front to back across it (snowShade) and a few iceDeep patches. Sculpt 6-8 snow drifts (squashed spheres/cones in snow and snowShade) pressed against where cabin, shed and mast bases sit. Scatter 4-5 low rock chunks (rock colour, angular boxes/prisms half-sunk) along the left, right and back edges. Build the raised plank deck at the deckTop mount: a plank (plank colour) platform ~1.9 x 1.1 with visible edge boards (timberLight), short timber stilt legs down into the snow, and 3-4 plank steps at the front edge down the drift. Also lay 2-3 flat stepping stones (rock) on the path toward the shed and mast. Keep the platform simpler than the buildings: broad shapes, no fine noise.
parts.attaches: Owns the ground line; deckTop mount is the exact deck surface where the cabin sits; snowPadRight and snowPadLeft are the flattened snow pads under the mast base and shed; drifts rise toward the other parts' boxes but stay below their boxes' floors.

parts.builds: The hero cabin on the deckTop mount, centred around x -0.3, z 0.05: a timber body (timber walls, horizontal plank boards suggested by 3-4 thin timberLight board strips as parts on each long wall) roughly 1.7 wide x 1.1 deep, from y 0.55 to y 1.95, with a steep gabled roof (roof colour) peaked at y 2.6, roofTrim fascia boards along the eaves, and a yellow trimYellow corner trim and door frame. Front faces +Z: a teal doorTeal door with a frameDark frame and trimYellow lintel, one big glowing windowGlow window left of the door and a smaller one right, both in frameDark frames with 2-3 muntin bars, plus a trimYellow-framed small gable window under the peak. A rock-coloured stone chimney climbs the right wall to y 2.9 with a frameDark cap and a smoke wisp: 4-6 smokePale cards drifting up and back on their own frames. Add a small porch: two timber posts, a plank awning strip of roof under the main roof line, and a glowing porch lamp (windowGlow dome on a steelDark bracket) beside the door. Signature detail: a trimYellow station sign board on the wall above the door with 3-4 small frameDark notches as painted lettering blocks, and a rope-and-post boot scraper by the steps.
parts.attaches: Rests exactly on the deckTop mount (floor at y 0.55); porch posts land on the deck; chimney and roof peak stay inside this box; nothing hangs below the deck.

parts.builds: A tall guyed radio mast at the snowPadRight mount (x ~1.35, z ~-1.7): three tapering steelDark leg rods converging from a triangular ~0.5 m base at y 0.4 to a single pole reaching y 4.5, with 5-6 horizontal steel cross-brace rings and X-braces (thin steel rods) up the height, and small steelDark platform collars. At the top: a dish (dish colour, a lathe or squashed-cone bowl ~0.45 across) on a short steel boom, tilted aiming up-forward (+Z, ~35 deg elevation) on the pole's front side at y ~3.4, with a feed horn rod in its centre. The tip carries a beaconRed glowing beacon dome (y ~4.5) and two thin steel whip antennas angled out. Three guy ropes (thin rope-colour rods) run from y ~3.8 down to three snow-anchored blocks (rock chunks on the snowPadRight pad). Halfway up add a small timberLight equipment box and a short crossarm with two tiny windowGlow lamp pods. Signature: a trimYellow and flagRed striped hazard band wrapped at the mast base and a small directional arrow vane (frameDark) under the dish.
parts.attaches: Base feet sit on the snowPadRight mount; guy-rope anchors land on the snow surface inside this box; the mast tip is the model's highest point.

parts.builds: The small storage shed on the snowPadLeft mount (centred x ~-1.15, z ~-1.65): a timber shed ~0.9 x 0.7 footprint, walls y 0.45..1.35 (timber with one timberLight board strip), a single-slope roof of roof colour with roofTrim edge, doorTeal double doors with frameDark frames and trimYellow hinges, a small glowing windowGlow porthole high on the side wall in a frameDark ring, and a short steel chimney stub. In front of the shed: a row of three upright tool handles/skis leaning against the wall (timberLight and steel), a barrel with a snow cap (barrel body, snow top) beside the door, and a dim trimYellow lantern hanging from the eave on a rope hook (glow). Beside the shed, a weather station: a timberLight pole to y 2.0 with a small white-lattice radiation shield box (snow colour), a rotating-cup anemometer of steel cross-arms and cups at the top, and a small flagRed pennant flag card on a short arm. Also build the far front-right windsock here: a steelDark pole at x ~1.5, z ~2.2 to y 1.7, with a horizontal steel arm and a snowShade-and-flagRed striped cone sock of cards or a swept cone pointing back (toward -Z, blowing inland), plus 4-5 fence posts (timber, frameDark caps) with two rope lines running along the front path between them.
parts.attaches: Shed floor rests on the snowPadLeft mount; weather pole and windsock poles and fence posts plant into the snow; flag and sock cards attach at their pole tips; all stays inside this box.

parts.builds: The working clutter of the station across the front strip (z 0.7..2.6) on the snow: a wood sled (crate-coloured runners and deck slats with crateLid rails, steel runner blades, a coiled rope rope-colour on top) lying flat near the path at x ~-0.6, z ~1.6; a stack of three crates (crate with crateLid lids and frameDark edge battens, one tilted, one with a trimYellow stencil bar) beside the cabin steps at x ~0.6, z ~1.0; a cluster of four fuel drums (barrel colour with two barrelBand rings each, one drum steelDark, one with a snow cap) standing in a loose ring at x ~1.3, z ~0.9; a compact snowmobile parked angled at x ~-1.0, z ~1.3 facing front-left: doorTeal body shell with trimYellow accent stripe, frameDark seat and windshield, steel skis and a small flagRed pennant on its rear rack; a pair of scattered snow-shoveled crates and a snow-covered plank; and 4-5 small details: a shovel (timberLight handle, steel blade) stuck in a drift, a steel bucket, a small stack of cut firewood (timber cylinders) by the shed path, and 3-4 tiny snow-topped crates half-buried near the back. Where snow sits on top of props, add snow-caps (snow colour flattened spheres/boxes) so everything reads as weathered in place.
parts.attaches: Everything rests on the snow surface of snowBase (tops of drifts vary; sink prop bottoms slightly into the snow); the sled and snowmobile flank the packed path; the crate stack leans against the cabin's front steps.

Every shape is a bold flat colour with chunky blocky silhouettes. Light faces are warm (snowLit, pink-cream), shaded undersides and snow shadows are cool violet (snowShadow, snowDeep), and every object has a small dark violet-ink underside or outline strip where it meets the ground. Keep shapes simple and add detail as small flat-colour parts (window panes, plank seams, rivets, stripes). Use warm sunset hues everywhere and no pure white or pure black.

parts.builds: The diorama slab: a chunky low-poly snow plinth, 7.2 x 7.2 m, top at y=0.4 with a darker snowShadow/snowDeep side skirt and a thin ink strip at the bottom, and ice-blue strata lines on the sides. On top: a few soft flat drift mounds (snowLit tops, snowShadow lee sides, up to y 0.45) kept away from the cabin footprint, a frozen pond (iceBlue disc with an iceDark rim, pale crack lines and a small round fishing hole) at the mount pondCenter, a trampled path of snowShadow flat strips from stairFoot to the front edge with small footprint ovals, and sled-track lines to the snowmobile pad. Add a few angular rocks (rock with snowLit caps) at the edges and corners, and 2-3 small ice crystals. Leave the areas for the cabin, yard objects and instrument bases free. It owns nothing above y 0.5.
parts.attaches: Top surface at the mount ground (y 0.4). Every other part rests on it. The backdrop starts at backdropFront z -2.95.

parts.builds: The hero research cabin facing +Z, built as a blocky puppet: 8 woodDark/wood stilts from ground to the deck at y 0.95, with cross-braces and snowLit drifts at their feet; a deck slab; cabinRed walls (x -1.7..1.7, z -1.3..0.7, y 0.95..2.35) with darker cabinDark plank seam strips and corner posts; trimCream window frames with windowGlow panes (3 on the front, 2 on each side, 2 on the back, each pane with a thin cross muntin) and small awning slabs; a porch deck (z 0.7..1.9, x -0.2..1.5) with a railing (wood posts and rail), a front door at doorCenter (wood, with a round window, a cream frame and a small lantern in windowGlow), an outdoor stair of 6 steps from porchEdge down to stairFoot with two stringers, and a snow stripe on each tread; a dark roofDark pitched roof (ridge y 3.0, along X) with overhanging eaves, a trimCream fascia, snowLit snow caps on the upper roof with chunky drip edges, a stove chimney (metal with a rock-cap, at x -1.0) with 2 flat smoke puffs of snowShadow and snowLit rising to y 3.9, a small red-and-cream sign board over the door reading a simple glyph, a side vent box and a stack of firewood (wood logs with trimCream ends) on the left side wall, and a small generator shed attached to the right wall (cabinDark, with a metal pipe). Bright windowGlow sparkle, an ink-coloured shadow band under the eaves.
parts.attaches: Stilts stand on the ground mount (y 0.4). The stair foot ends at stairFoot [0.6, 0.4, 2.7], which lies just outside the box; the path from the base starts there. Keep clear of the instruments at z < -1.5.

parts.builds: The scientific gear behind the cabin, z -2.9..-1.5. (1) A radome at radomeBase: a three-legged metal lattice tower (metalLight, with cross-braces) about 1.4 m tall carrying a faceted trimCream/snowLit dome (about 0.9 m across, from a low-poly sphere) with panel seam lines in snowShadow, a red beacon light and a small hatch; the dome centre is near y 2.4. (2) A wind turbine at turbineBase: a tapered white-cream tower to the hub at turbineHub [2.4, 3.4, -1.95], a nacelle box with a cabinRed nose cone, and three tapered blades, 1.0 m long, on the joint turbineRotor (rigged to the joint, facing +Z, blades at 0, 120 and 240 degrees, with a sunOrange tip stripe on each) — the hub and blades ride the joint turbineRotor. (3) A weather mast at mastBase: a thin metal pole up to y 4.5 with 2 cross-arms, guy wires (thin ink rods) anchored in the snow, a small instrument box, and an anemometer on top riding the joint anemometer (3 cups on arms, sunOrange cups). (4) A solar panel rack at x 0.9..1.7, with 2 tilted iceDark panels with lighter grid lines and a metal frame on legs, tilted to face +Z. (5) A little Stevenson-screen weather box (trimCream louvers, wood legs) near x -0.9. Add snow drifts piled at all bases and a thin ink-coloured cable run from the mast base towards the cabin back wall, ending at (0, 1.1, -1.4).
parts.attaches: Bases stand on the ground mount (y 0.4) at radomeBase, mastBase and turbineBase. Its cable ends at the back wall of the mainCabin (z -1.4). The backdrop is behind at z < -2.95.

parts.builds: Everything staged around the cabin outside the cabin box (x -1.9..1.9, z -1.4..1.9), and out of the pond (x 1.5..3.2, z 1.8..3.3), in blocky puppet style. (1) A snowmobile at snowmobilePad, facing +Z: a cabinRed body, a black-ink seat, a trimCream windscreen, a headlight in windowGlow, ski runners (metal) front and a track block rear with snow-capped tread details, and a sunOrange stripe; behind it a wooden sled (wood, woodDark runners) carrying a tarp-covered load (sunOrange tarp, with rope lines) and two small boxes. (2) A stack of cargo at cratePad: 5 wooden crates (wood with woodDark slats and a stencilled trimCream glyph) stacked in a pyramid, with 3 fuel drums (sunOrange and cabinDark, with ink bands, metal lids and bungs) beside them and a snow cap on top. (3) In front: a flag pole at flagPad (metal pole, a cabinRed flag with a trimCream stripe, flat but a few facets tall), an ice-core rack (a wood A-frame with 6 horizontal iceBlue core tubes) near x 0.2, z 2.8, and an orange survey tent at tentPad (a sunOrange low pyramid or dome with trimCream guy lines, a dark door flap and snow skirts). Add a pair of skis and poles leaning against the cabin front-left stair rail (outside the cabin box, so near x -2.1, z 1.9), and a lone ice axe in a snowdrift. All objects get a small snowShadow drift at the base.
parts.attaches: All items rest on the ground mount (y 0.4) at their named pads. Keep clear of the pond region (x 1.5..3.2, z 1.8..3.3), the path from stairFoot, and the cabin box.

parts.builds: A flat sunset diorama wall along the back edge (z -3.6..-2.95, x -3.6..3.6, standing on the base from y 0.4 to 5.0), built from thin extrudes or slabs in a stack of z layers. Layer 1 (z ~ -3.55): sky bands as full-width horizontal strips: skyTop at the top, then skyMid, then skyGlow at the horizon, with a thin sunOrange band right above the ridges. Layer 2: a huge sun disc at sunCenter [1.2, 3.3, -3.45], radius about 0.75, in sunYellow with a sunOrange ring and 2 larger halo rings (skyGlow tones, flat) behind it, and a few thin flat horizontal cloud streaks in ridgeFar and skyMid across the sky. Layer 3: aurora ribbons, 2-3 wavy thin extruded bands in iceBlue and trimCream near the top. Layer 4: far ridge silhouette (ridgeFar, jagged peaks up to y 2.8) at z -3.4. Layer 5: mid ridge (ridgeMid, peaks up to y 2.2) at z -3.3 with snowLit snow-cap triangles on peaks. Layer 6: near ridge (ridgeNear, peaks up to y 1.5) at z -3.15 with a few tiny snowLit highlights on the sunward slopes. Frame the wall with a thin ink-coloured border (a flat box frame around the edge, 0.08 m) so it reads like a stage flat, plus two rear brace struts at the back. All pieces are flat-coloured, tall angular silhouettes with sharp peaks. The sun and ridges must not intrude on z > -2.95, so leave the instrument zone free.
parts.attaches: Stands on the base's back edge at y 0.4. Its front face is at backdropFront z -2.95. The mast top (y 4.5) and turbine blades (up to y 4.4) stand in front of it.

calls.reasoning:
I'm settling on the look first: a Firewatch-style flat palette of warm sunset oranges, pinks and purples, but set in the arctic with snow, ice and pine silhouettes. The outpost is the focus, with only a simple snowy base slab under it. I'm also sketching a rough size for the base, roughly 8 by 8 with a height around 4.5, though I'm still weighing those numbers.

I'm sizing the base to a 7 by 7 footprint at about 4.6 tall, then breaking the diorama into five parts. The terrain is a snowy ice slab with drifts and rocks, sitting at about y=0.4. I'm also laying out the main lab on stilts and weighing where the instrument mast and wind turbine should go on the back right.

I'm placing the cabin on the middle line of the base, and I'm fixing the instrument cluster behind it at the back, with the radome and wind turbine on either side of a ground-level mast. The front yard gets its own box for the snowmobile, fuel drums, crates, tent and the other gear.

I'm weighing a sky backdrop of layered flat mountain ridges with a big sunset disc behind the outpost. The fit is tight, since the instruments sit at the back, so I'm considering stretching the diorama's length to about 8 to make room for it.

I'm working out the backdrop now: layered flat ridges at the back, a sun disc with halo rings, and a size of about 7.2 by 5 by 7.2 so everything fits, with the base slab running from -3.6 to 3.6.

I'm adding aurora bands to the backdrop, then turning to the base, which will get drifts, ice cracks and a frozen pond. I'm also weighing whether the model should have joints, probably a root with rotating turbine and anemometer parts.

I'm setting the joints now: the outpost root is the spine, with the wind turbine rotor and the anemometer as hinges on the instrument side, and everything else riding on the root. I'm also picking the palette, starting with a deep purple sky top and a mid-tone magenta, with the sun's orange still to be settled.

I'm listing the colour palette now, with warm snow whites, icy blues, rock greys, a red cabin with cream trim, wood tones, and warm window glow.

I'm checking the colour list against the limit of 24, adding a few more candidates and then trimming it to exactly 24 by dropping the extras.

I'm placing the cabin on stilts, with its walls running from the deck up to a ridge roof, and a porch and stair on the front side facing the yard. The cabin footprint spans the middle of the base, and the yard box begins just in front of the porch.

I'm laying out the yard's footprint so it doesn't collide with the cabin: the cabin takes the middle block, and the yard fills the space around it, with the snowmobile set out to the side.

I'm placing the cabin's chimney on the roof at x=-1.0, with the cabin box running up to 3.9 to take in the smoke puffs. Then I'm turning to the instruments: the radome base goes on a tower at x=-2.3, z=-2.3, and the wind turbine at x=2.4, z=-2.2, with its hub around 3.3 and blades reaching roughly 4.3, while I'm still weighing where the mast fits.

I'm placing the instrument joints now: the anemometer sits up on the mast at about y=4.5, and the turbine rotor is set on the hub at the right side of the back.

I'm placing the backdrop as a box behind the instruments, with the ridge layers at the far back, the sun disc off to the right, and a sky panel built from stacked horizontal gradient strips from deep purple at the top down to the orange horizon.

I'm placing the pond at the right front corner of the base, where the yard can keep clear of it, and setting the ice drill and a small fishing hole beside it.

I'm placing the yard on the left side with the snowmobile and its sled, and setting the crates and fuel drums on the right, with the orange tent in the front-left corner.

I'm placing the yard's pieces around the base: the snowmobile and sled on the left, the crate stack and fuel drums on the right, and the flag pole, ice-core rack and orange survey tent in the front zone, keeping clear of the pond.

Category: Diorama.
Subject: arctic research outpost.

spec.name: Polar Outpost Seven
spec.description: A Firewatch-style diorama of an arctic research outpost: a red-sided stilted hab with a glowing porch, a teal lab annex with a radome joined by a corridor, a radio mast and generator shed, and a yard of sleds, drums and a snowmobile. It stands on a cut-away snow slab in front of layered sunset ridges and a big low sun.
spec.layout:
STATIC DIORAMA, no joints. A 10 x 9 m snow slab (x -5..5, z -4.5..4.5) with its top surface at groundTop y = 0.5. The slab's cut edge shows strata. The tallest thing is the radio mast (6.2 m, back-left). The sun sits low behind the back ridges.

FRONT (+Z) TO BACK: stairs and path, then the hab porch at z ~1.7 and the hab body (z -2.3..1.3). Behind the hab are the mast, the stacked ridges and the sun.
LEFT SIDE (+X) is the viewer's right. The corridor runs from the hab to the teal lab (x 2.2..4.6, z -2.2..0.4) with a radome on its roof. The front yard (sled, snowmobile, drums, weather screen, flag) is in front of the lab at x 1.4..4.8, z 0.8..4.4.
RIGHT SIDE (-X) is the viewer's left. The generator shed stands at x -4.8..-3.5 and the lattice mast at x -4.1, z -3.0.

Buildings are raised on short dark-wood stilts. Hab floor and corridor floor are at y 1.1; the lab floor is also 1.1. All buildings sink 0.05 into the ground.

STYLE (Firewatch flat colour), applied by every part:
- Every surface is one flat colour with a faceted, low-poly look and no outlines. Forms are big and simple: chunky boxes, simple pitched roofs, few segments (6-8 sides on cylinders).
- The sun is low and warm, coming from +X and a little +Z. LIT faces are the top, +X and +Z faces. SHADED faces are the -X and -Z faces.
- A shaded face is not darker grey. It is covered by a thin 0.02 m shade slab hugging the whole -X (and -Z) face in the paired shade colour: wallRed -> accentRed, trimCream -> snowMid, tealPanel -> deepTeal, wood -> darkWood, radomeWhite -> snowShade, metal -> ridgeNear, roofDark -> ink, snowLit -> snowShade (and snowDeep for the deepest crevices).
- Cast shadows are flat, thin slabs (0.01 thick) in snowShade lying on the ground. They fall toward -X and a little toward -Z, about 1.2 m long. Each part lays its own shadows at its own height: hab y=0.506, lab y=0.508, mast/shed y=0.510, yard y=0.512 (terrain surface is y=0.5, packed path 0.503), so they never z-fight.
- Windows and lanterns are the glow accent: windowGlow and yellow parts, with glow() applied. Snow caps are lumpy snowLit slabs with a scalloped lip, snowShade underneath. Icicles are tiny iceBlue cones.
- Colour is warm on top and cool below. The ridge backdrop is a Firewatch gradient made of three layers (peach far, mauve mid, indigo near).

parts.builds:
The diorama base and scenery behind and around the buildings.
1) SLAB: x -5..5, z -4.5..4.5, y 0..0.5, shown as cut-away strata. Bottom 0..0.18 is rock, 0.18..0.38 is iceBlue with a few wavy snowMid seams, and the top 0.38..0.5 is a snowLit cap whose edge lip is scalloped with overhanging lumps. The front and sides are visible, so give the strata faceted wavy steps. The slab's top (y=0.5) must be flat under the building footprints, because other parts' bottoms sit at 0.45.
2) SURFACE DETAIL: low faceted snow drifts as flattened lumps (snowLit lit side, snowShade -X side), only in the margins (x beyond +-4.3, z>4.1, and along the left edge). Keep them below y 0.85. Wind-ripple strips in snowMid. Packed-path decals (snowMid, y 0.503) from the stairFoot at [0.4,0.5,3.2] to the front edge at z=4.5, a branch to the yard and a branch toward the lab front at z ~0.9. Footprint dents as small snowShade ovals along the paths. Three small rock clusters (rock, ridgeNear shaded sides, snowLit caps) at about (-4.3, 3.0), (4.6,-2.8) and (-1.8, 4.1).
3) PINES: a stand of 5-6 stylised Firewatch pines in pine with ridgeNear shaded sides, 3 stacked cones each, snow-capped in snowLit, 0.9-1.8 m tall, in the front-left corner around (-4.2, 3.6) and a pair at (4.5,-3.2). Keep them outside other boxes.
4) BACKDROP: three stacked extruded ridge silhouettes spanning x -5..5 as thin plates (0.25 thick, each narrower on top as a jagged mountain skyline with a few snowLit peak caps): far ridge ridgeFar at z=-4.3, peaks up to y=3.4; mid ridge ridgeMid at z=-3.95, peaks up to y=2.6; near ridge ridgeNear at z=-3.65, peaks up to y=1.8. Their bases sink to y 0.45. Add snowShade streaks and a few snowLit caps on the mid and near ridges.
5) SUN: a sunOrange disc radius 1.0 (low-segment cylinder facing +Z) at sunDisc [2.5,2.4,-4.45], with a larger yellow disc radius 1.35 just behind it (z=-4.47). Optionally two thin arc bands of ridgeFar floating behind as haze. The sun must stay behind the far ridge's z (-4.3) and sit partly hidden by it.
No buildings, mast or props: other parts own those.
parts.attaches: Provides groundTop (y=0.5) that every other part sits on, stairFoot where the hab's stairs land (path starts there), and the ridge band at z<=-3.55. Keep the surface within x -4.8..4.8 flat and free of lumps near mastBase, generatorShed, sledCentre, snowmobile and drumCluster.

parts.builds:
The main living cabin, the hero building. BODY x -3.05..1.2, z -2.3..1.3 (walls x -2.9..1.2). Floor deck at y=1.1, walls to y=3.3, pitched roof with ridge along Z at y=4.1 (eave overhang 0.2, eaves to x -3.05 and x 1.4, but keep the porch x<=1.2 and the lab corridor mount clear: the right wall x=1.2 is the corridor start).
CONSTRUCTION: 8 stilt posts (darkWood, 0.18 square) from y 0.45 to 1.1 with cross-bracing X boards (wood), skirt boards (darkWood) between them on the shaded back and left sides. Walls in wallRed (lit faces) with horizontal cream (trimCream) siding lines every ~0.35 m on the lit +Z and +X faces, corner posts trimCream, a trimCream fascia band under the eave and darkWood base band. Shade slabs (accentRed) on the -X and -Z faces. Roof: two planes roofDark with a trimCream bargeboard along the gable edges, a lumpy snowLit snow layer on top of both planes with scalloped lip and snowShade underside plus iceBlue icicles along the front eave. A metal stovepipe (chimney) at (-1.9, 3.7, -1.2) up to y 4.8 with a cap, a thin ink soot ring and a snowLit snow cap.
FRONT (+Z): trimCream door frame at habDoor x=0.4 with a wood door (darkWood panels, a little yellow window, brass-yellow knob), a darkWood nameplate board above it with three small trimCream blocks as a number plate, and a yellow lantern (glow) hung on the porch beam at (1.0, 2.6, 1.6). Two big windows at x -2.0 and x -0.9 (y 1.8..2.8): trimCream frames, windowGlow glass (glow), darkWood mullion cross, interior shade stripe, snowLit sills with snow. Gable window (small round windowGlow) in the front gable at y 3.7.
PORCH: deck x -0.4..1.2, z 1.3..2.1 at y 1.1 (wood planks with darkWood gaps), posts at the front corners holding a small roof shed (roofDark with snow cap) at y 2.9, railings (darkWood) on the +X side and front with a gap at the stairs (x 0..0.8). A firewood stack (wood logs ends in trimCream) at x -0.2..0.0 on the porch, a pair of boots by the door.
STAIRS: darkWood stringers + wood treads, 6 treads from porch edge (z 2.1, y 1.1) down to stairFoot (0.4, 0.5, 3.2), x 0..0.8, with two handrails.
SIDE (+X wall, z -0.6): the corridor opening, a trimCream square frame 0.9 wide x 1.3 high at y 1.1..2.4 where the corridor joins, with a darkWood door flap. -X wall: one windowGlow window and a vent. Back wall: a vent and a roof-edge snow lump.
CAST SHADOW: a flat snowShade slab at y 0.506 on the ground, extending from x -3.05 to -4.3 and z -2.6 to 2.9 as a stretched parallelogram going toward -X/-Z. Also a short shadow under the stairs.
parts.attaches: Stands on groundTop via stilts. Stairs end on stairFoot (0.4,0.5,3.2). The right wall opening at corridorStart (1.2,1.1,-0.6) receives the lab corridor. Roof and walls must not exceed x=-3.05..1.4 so the mast part (x<=-3.2) and lab part (x>=1.2, built above the corridor) stay clear. Porch front at z=2.1 is the max; stairs reach z=3.2.

parts.builds:
The science lab annex, its corridor and radome. All at the hab's right (+X).
CORRIDOR: from corridorStart [1.2,1.1,-0.6] to corridorEnd [2.2,1.1,-0.6], a hexagonal tube 1.1 wide, 1.2 tall (y 1.1..2.3), in tealPanel with deepTeal shade slab on the -Z side, trimCream rings every 0.25 m, one small windowGlow porthole on the +Z side, a short darkWood stilt pair under it, a snowLit snow strip on top. A trimCream collar where it meets the hab wall and the lab wall.
LAB BOX: x 2.2..4.6, z -2.2..0.4, floor y=1.1, walls to y=3.0, flat roof with a very slight pitch plus a snowLit lumpy snow layer with scalloped lip (top y ~3.15). Stilts: six darkWood posts y 0.45..1.1. Walls tealPanel (lit +X, +Z), deepTeal shade slabs on -X and -Z faces, a trimCream band at y 2.8..2.95 and corner posts, ink base band. Front (+Z) face: a wide strip window at y 1.8..2.5 (windowGlow glass with glow(), trimCream frame, darkWood mullions every 0.6), a metal door at x=3.9 with a yellow warning stripe and a small hazard sign (yellow square with an ink bolt shape), a wooden step. +X face: a vent grille (ink slats on metal), a duct in metal, an accentRed fire-extinguisher box. Roof: two metal vents with snow caps, a yellow-capped skylight, a square instrument box (trimCream) with an ink-and-windowGlow indicator.
LADDER: on the front face at x 4.4, metal rungs from y 1.1 to 3.0 with side rails and a safety cage hoop at the top.
RADOME TOWER: a metal 4-leg lattice tower on the roof from y 3.1 to 4.0 at labRoofCentre [3.4,3.0,-0.9], footprint 0.9 square, X-braces, a platform deck (darkWood) at y 4.0 with a railing ring (metal). On it the radome at radomeCentre [3.4,4.6,-0.9]: a faceted sphere radius 0.65 in radomeWhite (lit) with snowShade shade slabs on the -X lower side (a hemisphere of facets built from slightly darker panels), thin ink seam rings and meridian bands as small flat strips seated on the surface, and a yellow beacon cone/bulb (glow) on the top at y ~5.3, a base ring of metal. Dome top at y ~5.3.
CABLES: sagging ink cables with tiny insulator blocks from the tower to the lab roof edge and from the lab to the corridor (thin sweeps).
CAST SHADOW: snowShade slab at y 0.508 from the lab toward -X/-Z about 1.2 m (partly under the corridor/hab edge, but not over x < 1.2 beyond what the hab shadow covers), and a smaller one for the radome tower on the roof (a snowShade parallelogram on the roof snow).
parts.attaches: Corridor starts at the hab's right-wall opening corridorStart [1.2,1.1,-0.6] and ends at the lab's -X wall at corridorEnd [2.2,1.1,-0.6]. Stilts stand on groundTop. The lab front (z=0.4) faces the yard; the yard part starts at z>=0.8 so the ladder and step stay clear. The radome rides labRoofCentre.

parts.builds:
The comms mast and power shed on the left (-X) side behind the hab.
MAST at mastBase [-4.1,0.5,-3.0] up to mastTop [-4.1,6.2,-3.0]: a triangular lattice tower 0.45 wide at the base tapering to 0.2 at the top, made of 3 metal legs (tapering rods) with horizontal ring braces every 0.5 m and X-braces between, ridgeNear shaded legs on the -X side, snowLit caps on the cross-braces in the upper half. A concrete-ish rock footing block with snowLit cap at the base. At y 5.2-5.6 a metal platform with three yellow-ish (yellow) antenna whips of different lengths, a red-white striped aircraft warning light: accentRed ball with glow at the very top (y 6.15) and a small yellow beacon below it. At y 4.6 a satellite dish: a faceted radomeWhite dish (shallow lathe/cone, radius 0.55) tilted ~35 degrees up towards +Z and +X on a metal arm and a feed horn (metal rod with ink tip), shade slab in snowShade on its back. A small trimCream equipment box (with ink lines) bolted on the mast at y 3.0 with a windowGlow status light.
GUY WIRES: three thin ink wires (sweeps, radius ~0.01) from the mast at y 4.5 to ground anchors A1 (-3.4,0.5,-3.4), A2 (-4.85,0.5,-3.4) and A3 (-4.85,0.5,-1.4). The anchors are darkWood stakes with metal eyes and snow mounds. Wires must stay at x <= -3.2 and z <= 1.2, clear of the hab body (x>=-3.05) and the ridges (z>=-3.6).
GENERATOR SHED at generatorShed [-4.15,0.5,0.0]: x -4.8..-3.5, z -0.9..0.9, on 4 darkWood skids, walls y 0.5..1.9 in darkWood (lit faces wood, shade slabs darkWood on -X, -Z), a gable roof with the ridge along Z (roofDark) peaking at y 2.4 with a lumpy snowLit snow cap and iceBlue icicles. Door on the +Z face (wood with trimCream frame, a small windowGlow slit window), a louvred vent (ink slats) on the +X face, an exhaust stack (metal) with a bent cap at the top plus a puff cluster of three snowLit-ish smoke lumps in snowMid, two short cable sweeps (ink) from the shed to the base of the mast, a fuel jerrycan or two (accentRed) by the door, two solar panels (deepTeal cells with trimCream frame and thin ink grid lines) on a metal tilt stand on the roof's lit slope, and a yellow warning label on the door.
CAST SHADOWS: snowShade slabs at y 0.510: mast shadow as a long thin streak going toward -X/-Z (clipped inside x>=-4.9, z>=-3.5), the shed's parallelogram toward -X (clipped to the slab edge x>=-4.95).
parts.attaches: Mast and shed stand on groundTop. mastBase and mastTop are listed in mounts. The shed's +X wall is at x=-3.5, leaving a 0.45 m gap to the hab's eave at x=-3.05. Nothing may reach x > -3.2. The mast's ground anchors lie at z <= -1.4 and inside the slab, and clear of the backdrop ridges (z >= -3.55).

parts.builds:
Everything standing in the open front-right yard x 1.3..4.8, z 0.8..4.4, y up to 2.4. Props are chunky and slightly toy-like. All sit on groundTop. Each prop lays its own snowShade shadow slab at y 0.512 toward -X/-Z (length ~0.8 for small things).

subject: axolotl
pitch:
Category: Animal.
Subject: axolotl with frilly pink gills.
Style: chibi.

spec.name: Chibi Axolotl
spec.description: A chibi axolotl with an oversized round head, a wide sleepy smile, stubby legs and six frilly pink gill stalks fanning from its cheeks.
spec.layout: A chibi axolotl facing +Z, standing on four stubby legs at y=0. The silhouette is dominated by the head: a wide, slightly squashed sphere centred at [0, 0.17, 0.13] (radius ~0.15) that takes almost half the model's length and overhangs a tiny plump torso behind it. The face reads at a glance: two huge glossy black bead eyes with white highlights low and wide on the front, pink blush discs under them, a wide gentle smile line curved across the lower front, two tiny nostril dots, and a cream chin/lower-jaw piece that sits slightly inside the head so the mouth can open. Behind and above the eyes, three gill stalks per side sprout from the head's flanks (upper-front, mid, lower-back) and sweep outward and back in a fan; every stalk carries rows of soft frilly filaments in pink-to-magenta, the signature feature, built richest. The torso is a short capsule from z=+0.05 back to z=-0.15, pale pink on top with a cream belly, blended under the head. Four stubby legs (front pair at z=+0.05, back pair at z=-0.10, hips at x=±0.085) drop straight down to round feet with three toes each, all touching y=0. The tail continues the torso line, tapering from the rump to a curled tip at z=-0.30, framed by pale translucent-looking dorsal and ventral fin folds. Everything is soft, round and toy-like: low-poly facets, no sharp edges, colour doing the work (warm pale pink up top, cream below, saturated magenta-pink only on the gills and blush so the face and gills pop).

parts.builds: The oversized chibi head and its whole face. One wide low-poly sphere (slightly squashed: scale ~[1.05, 0.92, 0.95], radius 0.15, centre [0, 0.17, 0.13]) in bodyPink, skinned over the head joint. Face pieces seated on its front surface: two huge glossy eyes (black ink spheres ~0.035 with small glossWhite highlight dots offset up-and-out, placed low and wide at roughly x=±0.065, y=0.15, z=0.26 facing forward), soft blush discs in blush under and slightly outboard of each eye, a wide gentle smile built as a thin curved extruded arc in ink across the lower front at y≈0.085 with small upturned corners, two tiny nostril dots in nostril above the smile, and faint ink eyelid crease lines above each eye. The lower jaw is a separate shallow cream (bellyCream) chin piece — a squashed half-sphere seated under the jaw joint at [0, 0.095, 0.20] — tucked inside the head silhouette so the mouth can open; the smile sits on the head, the chin on the jaw. A few tiny bodyShadow freckle dots scatter on the top of the head. All face details are their own parts in their own palette colours, seated flush on the head surface.

spec.description: A chibi axolotl with a huge round head, frilly coral-pink external gills, a wide contented smile and a broad ribbon tail, standing on four stubby legs.
spec.layout: A chibi salamander facing +Z, roughly one-third head, one-third body, one-third tail. The torso is a short plump capsule lower than the head, with a cream belly and a faint dorsal ridge. Four very short stubby legs (front pair at the chest, hind pair under the hips) end in little rounded feet with three toes each, and they are the only parts touching the floor. The tail is a thick root that tapers into a broad flat fin ribbon sweeping back to z = -0.62, with a slightly transparent-look lighter fin edge. The style is bold and toy-like: every shape a chunky primitive, gills and smile oversized, cheeks blushing, belly pale, all flat colours with the coral gills as the loudest accent against the soft pink skin.

Skull: a large rounded dome (sphere or lofted capsule roughly 0.34 m wide and 0.3 m tall) in skin pink, slightly wider than tall, with a short blunt snout box/loft protruding to z = 0.4 in skin pink with a cream chin and underside. Face (all on the head bone, nothing in front of the eyes): two small glossy bead eyes (dark ink spheres with a white shine stud each) set wide at about x = ±0.1, y = 0.26; tiny ink nostril dots on the snout tip; a very wide smile built as a shallow swept ink mouth line across the front from x = -0.11 to x = 0.11 with small upturned corner ticks; rosy blush ovals (flat pink discs) under each eye. The signature feature: three gill stalks per side rising from the head's upper sides on the gillLT/gillLM/gillLB joints, each stalk a short tapering sweep in gill coral that fans outward and back, and each stalk carrying 5-7 soft frilly filaments (small tapered spikes or short swept fronds alternating gill coral and gill light) branching off both sides along its length, the fronds longest on the top stalk so the crown reads instantly. Give each gill joint a small rest-pose splay so the frills are separated and readable.
parts.attaches: The skull's lower back sits over the neck mount [0, 0.22, 0.12], overlapping the body part's front; its underside meets the jaw mount. All geometry rides the head, jaw and gill joints.

parts.builds: The plump torso between head and tail. A short horizontal capsule or loft (about 0.24 m wide, 0.14 m tall, from z = -0.26 to z = 0.14) in skin pink, sagging slightly lower at the belly. parts.builds: Four stubby chibi legs with feet and toes.
