spec.name: Pinky the Axolotl
spec.description: A chibi, plush-proportioned leucistic axolotl lying on its belly, with a huge smiling head, glossy bead eyes, stubby four-fingered limbs, a finned tail and six frilly pink gill plumes.
spec.layout: Chibi toy proportions in metres, scaled so the whole animal is about 0.74 m long. The axolotl lies on its belly with all four limbs splayed. From the front (+Z) to the back: a big, wide, flat-topped, rounded head (about 0.32 wide, 0.26 tall, 0.31 long, roughly 45% of the body length) with the snout rounding off at z about 0.36. The face is a wide upturned smile, tiny nostril dots, two big glossy black bead eyes high on the front corners of the skull with white highlights, and round pink blush discs on the cheeks. Behind the head sit three feathery gill plumes on each side, fanning out sideways, up and back like a ruffled collar. They are the signature feature and the widest and tallest part of the silhouette: the upper plume rises about 45 degrees, the middle one is nearly horizontal and the lower one droops slightly. Behind the head is a short, plump, rounded torso (radius about 0.09) with a pale belly. Four tiny stubby limbs stick out sideways and flat, the front pair just behind the head under the gills and the hind pair at the rear of the torso. Each ends in a small paddle hand or foot with four rounded little fingers or toes. The tail is short and laterally flattened, tapering to a rounded tip at z about -0.37. A continuous soft frilled dorsal fin crest runs from the back of the head over the torso and widens into a tall ribbon fin around the tail. Everything is soft, rounded and blocky, with a few facets showing. Colour sits in zones. The main skin is warm pink with a lighter cream-pink belly and chin. Small darker pink freckles are scattered over the head, back and tail. The gills fade from salmon stalks through hot pink frills to pale pink tips. Dark ink is used only for eyes and the mouth line. The head, torso, limbs and tail all rest on the floor (lowest points y 0 to 0.005). The gills and the dorsal crest sit above it.

parts.builds: The chibi head, with the face settled first. A wide, flat-topped rounded skull (radii about 0.16 wide, 0.12 tall and 0.15 deep, centred on headCenter) in skin, with a lighter skinLight top plate and a skinShade underside band. The mouth is built as a separate upper and lower jaw. The upper jaw is a broad rounded snout block ending at snoutTip, and the lower jaw is a shallower, slightly narrower rounded block on the jaw joint, with a belly-coloured chin. Between them runs a wide upturned smile line in mouth colour, built as a thin sweep that curves up at both corners to about x +/-0.12, with a small tongue wedge (tongue) inside the lower jaw and tiny dark smile-corner dimples. Two big glossy bead eyes at eyeL and eyeR (sphere radius about 0.035, colour eye) sit slightly proud of the skull in low rings of eyeRim lids, each with a large eyeShine highlight sphere at the upper-inner front and a smaller second shine at the lower-outer side. Add small raised brow-ridge bumps above the eyes. Two tiny nostril dots (nostril) sit on top of the snout. Round flat blush discs (blush) sit on the cheeks at cheekL and cheekR, facing outwards and forwards. A handful of small freckle discs (freckle) and a few gold specks (gold) are seated on the top of the head. Do not build gills here, and keep everything in front of the gill roots.
parts.attaches: Skull rides joint head and sits on the chest and torso at neckJoin. The lower jaw rides joint jaw, hinged at jawHinge. Gills root on the back sides of the skull at gillRoot* mounts, and the head part leaves those clear.

parts.builds: Six frilly gill plumes (three per side, mirrored), the signature feature and the richest build in the model. Each plume has a thick tapering curved stalk (sweep, gillStalk, radius about 0.012 tapering to 0.005) that grows from its gillRoot* mount along the joint direction. Lengths: upper (index 1) about 0.17, middle (index 2) about 0.16, lower (index 3) about 0.13. Along each stalk sit 8 to 10 feathery filaments on both the upper and lower sides, built as slim flat leaf-shaped extrudes or thin tapered spikes about 0.03 to 0.05 long. They are longest at the middle of the stalk and shorter towards the root and tip, and they fan out alternately and angle back towards the tip, making a bottle-brush or fern look. Colours go root-to-tip: gillStalk on the stalk, gillFrill on the filament bodies, gillTip on the outer ends, with a tiny gillTip bud sphere at the stalk end. Each plume rides its own gill joint, and the builder may add tip joints named gillL1b, gillL2b and so on (same pattern for R) for the outer half of each stalk, with role fan. Plumes may overlap their neighbours slightly but must not poke into the face. The whole spread should reach x about +/-0.29 and y about 0.34 at the highest tip.
parts.attaches: Stalk bases are embedded about 0.01 inside the skull at gillRootL1/2/3 and gillRootR1/2/3. Each plume rides gillL1..3 and gillR1..3, which are children of joint head.

parts.builds: The short, plump chibi torso: a rounded loft (radius about 0.09, centre y about 0.09) from just behind the head at z about 0.1 back to torsoBack at z -0.12, in skin. The upper half has a skinLight back sector and the belly has a cream belly underside band (use sweep sectors). Add a flat belly-coloured patch on the floor-facing underside, fine soft gold and freckle spots scattered over the back and flanks (small flattened spheres or discs seated on the surface), and small skinShade shoulder and hip bulges where the limbs attach. Add a subtle row of 4 to 5 tiny gill-slit-like gold dimples is not wanted; instead add a few pale costal groove lines (thin curved sweeps in skinShade) along each flank. The torso hides all limb roots, and the head covers its front end.
parts.attaches: Rides hips and chest. The front end is buried in the back of the head at neckJoin. The rear end meets the tail's first ring at torsoBack/tailRoot with the same radius, so they read as one body. Limbs root at shoulderL/R and hipL/R.

parts.builds: Four tiny splayed limbs built as tapering sweeps along the joint chains. The front pair runs shoulderL > elbowL > handL, and the hind pair runs hipL > kneeL > footL (R mirrored at -x). Each limb is a stubby skin tube (radius about 0.022 at the root, tapering to about 0.016 at the wrist), with a little round elbow or knee knob. The end of each is a flat rounded paddle palm (toe colour) with exactly four rounded little fingers or toes fanned out, each a short capsule about 0.025 long and 0.008 radius in toe with a toeTip bead on the end. The builder adds digit joints named fingerL1..4 and fingerR1..4 under handL/handR and toeL1..4 and toeR1..4 under footL/footR, with role digit. Front hands point forward and outwards, and hind feet point back and outwards. Palms and toes rest flat on the floor, with the underside at y about 0 to 0.003. Add a couple of freckles on the upper arm and thigh.
parts.attaches: Limb roots are buried slightly into the torso at shoulderL/R and hipL/R. They ride joints shoulder/elbow/hand and hip/knee/foot plus the digit joints. The front limbs sit below and clear of the gill plumes, and the hands stay clear of the head sides.

parts.builds: The tail and the fins. The tail is a laterally flattened tapering sweep or loft from the torso at tailRoot (radius about 0.075 round) to a soft rounded tip at tailTip (about 0.012 wide and 0.05 tall), over chain tail1..tail4, in skin with a belly-coloured underside strip and a few freckles and gold specks. Above it is the dorsal fin crest, a continuous soft ribbon (extrude or membrane, finMain) that starts at dorsalStart, at the back of the head and torso, and runs back over the torso, growing in height from about 0.03 to about 0.09 above the spine line at the tail. It wraps around the tail tip and returns as a lower ventral fin along the underside of the tail for the last 0.15 m. The fin has a wavy scalloped finEdge rim, thin radial finRay lines (tiny rods or extruded slivers in finRay) and a few tiny freckle spots on the fin. Keep the fin thin (about 0.006 thick). The lowest points of the tail, belly and ventral fin touch the floor (y 0 to 0.005).
parts.attaches: Tail tube rides tail1..tail4 and starts at tailRoot, matching the torso end radius. The dorsal crest rides the nearest of hips, chest and tail1..tail4 and sits on the torso top at backTop/dorsalStart, which the torso leaves clear.

spec.name: Baba Yaga's Hut on Chicken Legs
spec.description: A Slavic folk-art log hut with carved trim and a red shingle roof, standing on two golden scaly chicken legs with big clawed feet, on a mossy mound with a stake fence and a mortar.
spec.layout: The hut faces +Z: a steep tented roof with a red shingle skirt rises from the cabin walls at y=3.0 to a ridge at y≈5.0, and the front gable is crowned by a carved wooden horse head (konёk) with a flax mane, so the hut's silhouette reads from the front as a pointed, beaked roof over a chunky cabin. The cabin is a square log izba, footprint x −1.5..1.5, z −1.8..1.8, from y=1.6 to y=3.0, built of stacked logs with visible round log ends at the corners; the front face carries a plank door with painted iron hinges and a small glowing amber lantern, flanked by two windows in tall white carved nalichniki frames with red-and-teal sun rosettes; a third window sits on the left flank. Below, two bird legs step down from the cabin's underside at the legAnchor mounts: feathered cream thighs with rust patches, golden scaly shins, backward-bent ankle hocks, and big three-toed feet with a rear spur that plant on the ground at y=0, one foot a half-step forward (z≈0.5) and the other back, giving the hut a walking pose. The ground part is a mossy mound with dirt edges filling the box below the hut, a few grey stones, two birch-stake fence posts topped by carved skulls, and a leaning wooden mortar with pestle beside the front foot. The folk style shows everywhere: carved white trim with zig-zag and solar rosette motifs, painted red and teal door and shutter accents, gold trim on the gable board, and thick chunky low-poly shapes throughout.

parts.builds: Two stylised chicken legs, mirrored, walking pose. Each starts at its legAnchor mount under the cabin: a feathered thigh of overlapping rounded feather layers (cream feathers with a few rust patches, built as tapered blades seated along the thigh tube), a chunky knee knob, a golden scaly shin (swept tube with small overlapping scale discs stuck on, gold legScale with inkDark outlines), a backward-bent ankle hock with a small feather cuff, and a big three-toed foot: a low foot pad, three forward toes of tapered segments with pale keratin claws that press into the ground, and one rear spur toe with its claw. Toes rest on the mossy mound at y=0. Thighs carry the hip and knee joints, shins the ankle joint, feet the toe joint. All leg parts ride hipL/kneeL/ankleL/toeL and hipR/kneeR/ankleR/toeR.
parts.attaches: Thigh tops plug into the cabin underside at mounts legAnchorL and legAnchorR, shared with the cabin part; toes touch the ground part at mount ground.

parts.builds: The log izba from y=1.6 to y=3.0: walls of stacked horizontal logs (warm log colour, a darker logDark row or two low down for shade), with round log-end discs proud at the four corners; a log floor rim and short hanging planks under the wall base. The front face (+Z) carries: a plank door (vertical planks in plank colour, painted iron strap hinges and a gold handle plate, a small carved architrave of trim wood, a tiny glowing amber lantern hanging beside it on a wrought bracket); two windows left and right of the door, each a dark shuttered opening in a tall carved nalichniki frame of trim white wood with a red-and-teal sun rosette at its crown, zig-zag carving strips down the jambs and a small shutter wing in paintTeal with paintRed accents. One further window on the left flank (−X), same frame style, smaller. A thin trim board runs along the wall top under the eaves. All cabin parts ride the body joint.
parts.attaches: Wall underside receives the legs at mounts legAnchorL and legAnchorR; wall top hands off to the roof at mount roofBase (y=3.0), shared with the roof part.

parts.builds: The steep tented roof over the cabin: two slopes of overlapping red shingle rows (roofRed with roofDark shadow rows near the eaves), scalloped row edges reading as hand-split wood shakes, rising from the eave plane at y=3.0 to the ridge at y≈5.0; a cream ridge cap of trim wood along the peak; cream eave boards wrapping the bottom edge; carved side wind boards (povoloty) with zig-zag motifs sweeping up the roof ends. The front gable at z≈+1.8 is filled with vertical plank fronton boards, a trim gable board framing it, a large carved gold solar rosette at its centre and red-and-teal painted horse motifs; the back gable is plain planks with a small rosette. At the ridge's front end sits the konёk: a carved wooden horse head in trim wood with an inkDark carved eye, a flowing mane of tapered gold-and-plank blades streaming back along the ridge, and small pointed ears. A chimney of short stacked logs pokes from the back slope near the ridge with three grey smoke puffs drifting up from its mouth. All roof parts ride the body joint.
parts.attaches: Eave plane rests on the cabin wall top at mount roofBase (y=3.0); the konёk head and ridge run above the gable peak of the cabin part.

parts.builds: The diorama base under the hut: a low mossy mound (moss green top, dirt-brown sloped rim) roughly filling the box footprint below y≈0.6, with lichen patches and a few scattered pebbles and two grey stones; the chicken feet plant into it at mount ground. Beside the front foot leans a carved wooden mortar (plank colour with a carved zig-zag band and rim cracks) with a thick pestle; near the back left stand two birch-stake fence posts (pale trim wood, pointed tops, inkDark carved faces) each topped by a small carved skull with dark eye sockets and a row of teeth; a cluster of two red-capped mushrooms with cream stems grows at the mound's edge. parts.attaches: Sits under everything; the legs part's toe claws press into its mound surface at mount ground, and it stays clear of the door approach.

spec.description: A folk-art diorama of Baba Yaga's log hut standing on two giant chicken legs on a round earth plinth, with a skull fence, a painted carved gable and a glowing window.
spec.layout: Front is +Z. A round earth plinth (radius 3.3, top at y=0.25) is the diorama base. A small porch deck and a steep stair come out of the door and run down to the plinth at z≈3.0, between the legs. A steep gable roof with its ridge along Z, eaves at y=3.75 and ridge at y≈5.2, has carved horse-head 'konyok' finials at both ridge ends, a painted front gable (fronton) with a sun rosette and a round glowing window, and a brick chimney on the right-back with smoke puffs. A ring of bone-pale skulls on pointed stakes fences the plinth edge (radius 2.9) from the back round to both sides, with a gap in front for the stair. Mushrooms, grass tufts, a mortar and a broom sit near the edge. Slavic folk art style: bold flat colour, a limited red, gold, blue, teal, cream and black palette. Everything is outlined or trimmed in contrasting small parts: carved zigzag and comb bargeboards, rosettes, stylised tulips and rooster motifs painted as small parts on the trim, the gable and the shutters. The wood is warm brown with pale cut log ends. The proportions are chunky and slightly toy-like, and the legs are oversized and characterful. Every part uses the shared motifs: the 8-petal sun rosette (gold centre, red petals, white dots), the zigzag border (red/white) and the tulip (red with green leaves).

spec.name: Baba Yaga's Hut on Chicken Legs
spec.description: A Slavic folk-art diorama of Baba Yaga's carved log izba standing on two giant scaly chicken legs in a clearing, ringed by a bone-and-skull fence with glowing eyes.
spec.layout: Diorama on a round earth-and-grass plinth (radius 3.0, top at y=0.15). The hut's log cabin (about 2.3 wide, 2.5 long, 1.4 tall) is lifted on two huge chicken legs to a floor height of y=1.6. It faces +Z. From the front, a plank stair with carved bannisters runs from the door down to the ground between the legs. The door is centred on the front wall under a steep gabled roof. The ridge runs front to back, and the front gable carries a carved pediment with a round window. Konyok (carved horse-head) finials cap both ridge ends. A stone chimney with grey smoke stands at the rear right. Two legs stand left and right (x = ±0.85) with knees forward, hocks back, and three forward toes plus one back toe gripping the ground, each toe ending in a dark claw. Feather pantaloons fluff over each thigh just under the floor beams. A ring of bone fence posts topped with skulls with glowing amber eyes circles the clearing at radius 2.4 and is open in a gap at the front (±35 degrees around +Z) for the path. Mushrooms, stepping stones, a birch tree at back left and a mortar and pestle at front left finish the scene. Folk-art style throughout: bold flat colours (red, blue, yellow, green, cream) painted as small parts on warm wood. Carved platbands around windows and door, saw-tooth and scalloped barge boards, sun and rosette motifs, hearts, and zig-zag borders. Every motif is built from small parts in outline (ink), main colour and highlight layers. Shapes stay chunky and blocky, like a puppet made of primitives.

parts.builds: Both giant chicken legs, mirrored left and right, built skeleton-first on the hipL/kneeL/ankleL/footL chains with sweeps. Each leg has a fat feathered thigh (a pantaloon of overlapping cream feather blades, root featherCream with tips legOrange) tucked under the floor beams at y=1.7. Below the knee the drumstick tapers into a scaly legYellow shin whose forward knee and back-pointing hock are clearly separated. A scale pattern of small legOrange plates and ridge rows runs down the metatarsus, with a spur on the back of the hock. A chunky foot pad leads into three forward toes (fanned apart, the inner one angled toward the centre) and one back toe. They are built as sweeps tapering into dark claw cones (claw) and have knuckle bumps and toe-pad ridges in legOrange. The toes rest flat on the ground top (y=0.15) and sink about 0.02. Leg parts ride hipL..toeBackR. Keep the stair gap between the feet clear: inner toes must not go past x=±0.5.
parts.attaches: Hip tops end at hipL and hipR inside the cabin foundation beams (hutFloor). Feet stand on groundTop at footL and footR.

parts.builds: The izba body, riding the hut joint. Underneath is a foundation frame at y=1.6..1.85 with cross beams and floorboard edge (logDark), sized x ±1.45, z ±1.5, so the leg hips vanish into it. Above are 7 courses of horizontal round logs (cylinders, alternating logLight and a slightly different logDark-tinted course) forming four walls. The wall surfaces sit at x=±1.15 and z=±1.25, spanning y=1.85..3.2. Corner log ends overlap and protrude to about 0.15 past the walls, with end-grain discs (logEnd) with ink ring lines. Moss-and-tow caulking is shown as thin grassDark strips between some courses. The front wall is a full-width solid wall (the door and windows are applied by the facade part on its surface, so do not cut any openings). The back wall has a plain small hatch of logDark boards and a carved carveRed strip. Add the hut's top plate (a flat logDark board ring at y=3.15..3.2) that the roof sits on. Add small carved details: carveYellow notch marks on the corner ends and a few knot-eyes (ink) on the logs.
parts.attaches: Sits on the legs at hutFloor and hipL/hipR. Its top plate meets the roof at eaveLine. The facade is applied to the front wall at z=1.25 and the side wall surfaces at x=±1.15.

parts.builds: Everything applied to the cabin's outside, front and sides. Door: a plank door in logLight and logDark on the door joint, hinge at x=0.42, filling x ±0.42 and y 1.85..2.9. It has an ink outline, iron-style strap hinges (ink), a ring handle, and a carved carveRed and carveYellow sun rosette in its upper half. It sits in a carved platband frame (carveBlue with carveWhite scallops and carveYellow dots), with a pediment hood above bearing a carved heart. A glowing skull lantern (bone skull, glow eyes) hangs above the door. A hand-towel (rushnyk) panel with a carveRed and carveWhite zig-zag pattern hangs beside it. On both side walls, a window with a dark ink pane that glows glow, carveWhite muntins, a carved platband in carveBlue with a carveRed scalloped crown, and two hinged shutters (carveGreen painted with carveYellow flowers). Each side window sits at windowL and windowR. A plank stair rises from the doorBase threshold (a small porch landing at z 1.25..1.55 with carved front edge) down to stairBottom (z 2.5), with 5 treads. Carved bannister posts and rails run on both sides, topped with small konyok-style carved knobs in carveRed and carveYellow. The stair stays within x ±0.5 between the legs. Colours stay bold and flat, with ink outlines under main colours and highlights.
parts.attaches: Front elements are seated on the front wall at z=1.25 (wallFrontCentre, doorBase). The side windows are seated on the side wall surfaces (windowL and windowR, x=±1.15). The stair foot rests on groundTop at stairBottom. The side-window box overflow to x ±1.3 is allowed. Rides the door joint (door) and hut.

parts.builds: A steep two-pitch gabled roof with its ridge along Z, from eave y=3.2 to ridge y=4.45, overhanging to x ±1.65 and z ±1.75. Shingle rows are overlapping flat boards (roofRed and roofWood alternating, with a few carveGreen moss patches on the upper faces), each with rounded or scalloped lower edges. A ridge beam (logDark) runs along the top. Konyok horse-head finials (carved logLight plus carveRed mane notches, ink eye) cap both the front end (ridgeFront) and the back end (ridgeBack). The front gable face is a solid board triangle (logLight vertical planks) at gableFace, with a round attic window (ink ring, glow pane, carveYellow sun rays) and a carved folk fringe (zig-zag barge boards in carveRed, carveBlue and carveWhite) along both front rafter edges, plus a hanging pendant at the apex and rosettes at the eaves. The back gable is plainer boards. A stone chimney (stone with logDark cap and a mortar line pattern) rises at chimneyBase to about y=4.7 with three smoke puffs (smoke, stacked faceted spheres, growing and drifting to +X). It reaches at most y=4.9.
parts.attaches: Sits on the top plate of the cabin at eaveLine (y=3.15..3.2). Everything rides the hut joint.

parts.builds: The diorama base: a low faceted disc of radius 3.0 (y=0..0.15) with a soil side wall (soil) and a grass top (grass) with a slightly irregular rim, rotated facets and a few grassDark patches. A path of 6 flat stone slabs (stone) leads from stairBottom to the front edge between the fence gap. Add scattered grass tufts (blade clusters in grass and grassDark), a few folk-art flowers (carveRed, carveYellow, carveWhite petals on green stems) and some roots/soil mounds at the base of the legs where the claws grip. Add flat stone rim pebbles around the edge. Keep the ground simple, with a flat top at y=0.15 so the toes and fence posts sit on it. Static, no smooth bending.
parts.attaches: Its top is the shared groundTop (y=0.15). The legs' toes, the stair foot and the fence posts all sit on it.

parts.builds: The bone fence and the scene props around the hut. A ring of about 18 posts at radius 2.4 around the clearing, skipping the front gap (within ±35 degrees of +Z, where the path goes). Each post is a long bone (bone cylinder shaft with knobbed ends) set slightly sunk into the ground, alternating heights 0.9..1.3, linked by two horizontal rail bones (bone). Every post is topped by a skull (bone, faceted sphere with jaw box, ink eye sockets with glowing glow pupils, nose notch and teeth row) turned to face inward or toward the viewer, with a few ordinary wood stakes between them. Additional props: a cluster of three fly-agaric mushrooms (mushRed caps with carveWhite dots and carveWhite stems) near the front right fence, a large birch tree (birch trunk with ink bark marks, a few branches, and carveGreen/grassDark leaf clumps) at back left around (-2.0, 0, -1.8), height up to 3.9, a stone mortar and a pestle (stone/logDark) at front left around (-1.7, 0.15, 1.2) with a small broom (logDark handle, carveYellow bristles), and a couple of boulders (stone) at the back right. Props keep to the circle of radius 2.9 and avoid the hut, legs and stair.
parts.attaches: All pieces stand on groundTop (y=0.15, sinking slightly). The fence opens on the fenceGapCentre line (z+). Static scenery, so ride hut for the rest pose.

subject: baku
pitch:
Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: baku, the dream-eating tapir spirit.
Style: ukiyo-e woodblock print.

spec.name: Baku, the Dream-Eater
spec.description: A great tapir spirit stands swallowing a glowing spiral of dream-mist that curls into its trunk, every surface a flat ukiyo-e colour field edged in ink with gold cloud trim.
spec.layout: A heavy, chunky tapir-spirit stands squarely on four short sturdy legs, front legs under the chest at z about +0.8 and hind legs under the rump at z about -0.8, cloven ivory hooves resting on y = 0 (only the legs part touches the floor). The barrel torso runs from chest z = +1.05 to rump z = -1.15, belly y about 0.6, back y about 1.5. The neck rises forward to a bold characterful head at z = +1.25: big almond eyes read from the front, a short curled elephantine trunk sweeps out and down from the face to the trunk tip at [0, 1.08, 1.98], an upper and lower jaw part so the mouth can open, two small bone tusks poke up from the lower jaw, and wide slab ears with pink inners and a gold flame-crest rise above the skull to y about 1.95. The style shows everywhere: the indigo coat is flat colour broken by a cream countershaded belly panel, cloud-spiral motifs (extruded teal-and-cream slabs with ink rims) are seated on the flanks and shoulder, every silhouette edge gets a thin dark ink part or ink-painted rim, and gold trim lines the hooves, crest and mane. Along the spine from neck to rump a mane of broad overlapping blades runs indigo-to-gold root to tip, and an ox-like tail drops from the rump ending in a gold-tipped tuft at z about -1.6. The signature: from the trunk tip a glowing spiral ribbon of dream-mist (mist white to mist blue, emissive) coils down and forward to z = +2.9, dotted with small star sparks, the dream being eaten.

parts.builds: The barrel body: one smooth loft over the spine joints from chest [0, 1.1, 1.05] to rump [0, 1.4, -1.1], widest at the belly (half width 0.45, belly y 0.6, back y 1.5), swept in indigo with a cream countershaded belly (sectors or a countershade paint). Details seated on it, each its own flat-coloured part: a cream belly panel edged with a thin ink sweep; three cloud-spiral motifs on the flanks and shoulder built as small extruded slabs of teal with cream spirals and ink rims, each placed on surface hits and sticking just out of the skin; a gold chest band swept as a loop round the chest just behind the forelegs mount; two small vermilion seal-like roundels on the rump flanks. Geometry rides the body joint (and neck for the shoulder area).
parts.attaches: Rises into neckBase toward the head part, meets shoulderLine and hipLine where the legs part hangs, and ends at rump where the mane and tail part takes over.

parts.builds: The head and trunk: a rounded skull (sphere or loft) on the head joint at skullCentre, faced forward, carrying the face. Big almond eyes that read from the front: white almond with ink outline and a dark teal pupil, one per side seated on the skull surface with an ink lid line; small gold brow strokes above. A short thick trunk built as a sweep along the trunk1-trunk2-trunk3 joints, tapering from 0.14 to 0.07 radius, indigo on top with a cream underside stripe, its tip flaring open with an ink inner ring; two nostril dots in ink at the tip. The upper jaw is part of the skull; the lower jaw hangs on the jaw joint as a smaller rounded frustum in indigoDeep with a vermilion tongue and cream gum line, built open a little. Two short ivory tusks curve up from the jaw sides (small tapering sweeps, horn colour). Wide slab ears (extruded rounded triangles, ink outline, blush inner, gold rim stud) splayed to each side above the eyes; a gold flame-crest of three tapered blade extrudes rises from the forehead between the ears. Ends exactly at trunkTip where the dream swirl enters.
parts.attaches: Skull sits on neckBase through the neck joint; trunk tip ends at mount trunkTip.

parts.builds: Four short sturdy pillar legs, one sweep tube per leg through hip, knee and ankle joints (radius 0.13 tapering to 0.09), indigo with a cream front stripe and an ink knee cap seated on each knee; joints bent to the given coordinates so the stance reads stable. Each foot is a cloven hoof on the toe joint: two chunky half-hoof extrudes in horn with an ink cleft and a gold band round the pastern, the hoof bottoms flat at y = 0. Small ink toe seams at the hoof fronts. All four legs share construction; mirror x for the right pair.
parts.attaches: Front pair hangs from shoulderLine, back pair from hipLine, each hip joint socketed into the torso underside.

parts.builds: The spine crest and tail: a mane of broad overlapping blades running along the spine from the back of the ears down to the rump (about 10 blades, each an extrude slab in the root-to-tip palette indigoDeep to gold, alternating heights, leaning back), rooted on surface hits along the spineCrest line. The tail hangs from rump as a sweep through tail1-tail2-tail3, thick at the root (0.08) and thinning, indigoDeep, ending in a tuft of 5-6 hanging tapered spikes in gold with cream tips at z about -1.6. Two or three small cloud-spiral slabs (teal and cream with ink rims, matching the torso motifs) float-stick beside the tail root so the spirit's back reads as one painted scroll.
parts.attaches: Mane roots along spineCrest on the torso back; tail roots at rump; the front of the mane box meets the head part's ears at the neck top.

parts.builds: The dream being eaten: a spiral ribbon of glowing mist rising out of the air in front of the trunk and threading into trunkTip. Built as two or three open spiral paths swept as thin flat ribbons (width 0.05-0.09, radius function tapering to a point), in mist white and mist blue, glowing via the glow kit at strength 1.2-1.5, with a fainter inner second spiral offset in phase. A dozen small star sparks (tiny four-point extrude slabs or octahedron parts) in white and gold, also glowing, scattered along the spiral with fixed rng; one slightly larger crescent-shaped wisp (extrude, mist) near the outer end of the spiral suggests a half-swallowed dream. The spiral starts in the air at about [0.15, 0.6, 2.7] and its inner end seats exactly into mount trunkTip, slightly embedded in the trunk opening. Nothing here touches the floor.
parts.attaches: Inner end of every ribbon seats at mount trunkTip on the head part's trunk3 joint; the rest floats free in front of and above the face.

spec.name: Baku, the Dream-Eater
spec.description: A baku—the dream-eating tapir spirit—standing proudly in ukiyo-e woodblock style: a heavy indigo barrel body with a cream belly, a gold crescent on its brow, a short prehensile trunk curling dream-smoke, wave-pattern bands on its flank and stylized cloud swirls pooled at its feet.
spec.layout: The baku stands on y = 0 on four short columnar tapir legs, facing +Z. Front to back: a short muscular trunk curls down and slightly forward from the front of a high, round-skulled head (ears at the top, small alert eyes, gold crescent moon emblem on the brow, small bone tusks at the jaw corners, jaw built as separate upper and lower pieces); the neck rises steeply from a heavy barrel torso whose back peaks around y = 1.5 at the shoulders and slopes to the rump; a ridge of flat blade-like mane tufts runs along the spine from the neck base to the tail base; a short lion-like tail curls up behind the rump with a bold tuft. The whole silhouette is chunky and rounded like a tapir blended with a guardian lion-dog. Style on every part: flat bold colours only, every surface one flat colour, with ukiyo-e detail built as separate seated parts—ink outline strips along edges, pale-blue seigaiha wave bands across the lower flank, gold collar and anklet bands, ink claw and nostril marks, and glowing teal dream-smoke wisps (emissive) curling from the trunk tip and drifting above the back. Stylized flat cloud swirls in pale blue with ink rims pool on the floor around the feet. Proportions pushed for character: the trunk slightly long and expressive, the ears large and round, the mane tufts bold and spiky, the belly deep and cream-bright against the dark indigo back.

Along the spine from neckBase to tailBase build the mane crest: 8-10 flat blade tufts (extrudes with sharp tips, thickness tapering to a knife edge) alternating ink, plum and gold, rooted on the back line and sweeping backward, tallest at the shoulders (about 0.22). Where the neck meets the body add a vermilion collar band: a swept band around the neck root with a thin gold trim ring on its front edge and small gold studs. spec.name: Baku, the Dream-Eater
spec.description: A stocky dream-eating baku spirit — an indigo tapir with a short trunk, cream saddle and gold trappings — built in flat ukiyo-e woodblock colours, with glowing dream wisps curling toward its trunk.
spec.layout: A quadruped spirit facing +Z, standing on four short sturdy pillar legs, feet flat on y = 0. The barrel torso runs z -1.3 (rump) to 1.3 (shoulder), belly at y 0.55, broad back at y 1.85, deep indigo like printed Prussian blue. A bold cream saddle band wraps the flank mid-body (the Malayan-tapir saddle) with a zig-zag ink edge; stylised ukiyo-e wave-scroll and seigaiha scallop pieces in pale mist-blue and gold sit as flat raised pieces on the upper flank, and a cream underbelly reads cooler and paler below. Front: a boxy skull on a short thick neck, small dark rhinoceros eyes with glowing gold irises set wide, a cream forehead blaze, and a short tapir trunk that droops from the face down to y 0.45 and curls slightly inward at the tip, ringed with faint gold bands; a two-piece jaw under it opens, with a dark vermillion-lined mouth and small cream tusks at the jaw corners. Large oval ox ears stand up at y ~2.2, dark outside, coral inside, gold-rimmed. A mane crest of broad ink-tipped blades runs along the spine from shoulder to rump (part 4) and an ox tail with a glowing gold tuft sweeps up behind the rump to z -1.9. Around the feet and flanks, a few flat stylised cloud wisps in mist-blue trail, and three or four glowing dream motes spiral in toward the trunk tip, as if being eaten. Every part wears ukiyo-e style: flat colours, thin sumi-ink outline strips seated along seams and edges, gold fittings, hard zig-zag colour breaks, no gradients.

Decoration on the upper flank, all as separate flat pieces seated just proud of the skin: three or four stylised wave-scroll swirls (extruded comma shapes, 'mist' with 'sumi' outline edges) on each side around the saddle, and a row of small seigaiha scallop discs ('cream' with 'gold' rims) arcing along the top of the back on each side. Gold trim: a thin gold band swept around the barrel just behind the shoulder and again at the flank under the saddle edge, each with tiny gold stud spheres. Add a vermillion circular family crest emblem (a flat extruded disc, vermillion with a gold ring and a small sumi swirl inside) seated high on each shoulder. A short sumi-ink mane strip runs along the topline. Belly is cream, shading to creamShade at the lowest faces; underside gets a faint indigoInk seam line where belly meets flank.
parts.attaches: Roots the neck at the 'neck' joint through neckMount (the head part continues the neck tube forward from there); the four legs socket into it at socketFL/FR/HL/HR (the legs part builds the limbs, this part builds the socket shadow rings of indigoInk on the skin around each socket); the tail mounts at tailMount and the mane crest sits along maneMount (both built by part 4).

parts.builds: The head, face, trunk, ears and jaw — the signature part, richest construction. Jaw: separate upper and lower jaw built on the 'jaw' joint — the lower jaw a short frustumBox slab under the muzzle, indigo, its inner mouth lined vermillion, with two small cream tusks curving up at the jaw corners and a cream chin patch; the mouth line between jaws is a thin sumi strip so the jaw can open. spec.name: Baku, the Dream-Eater
spec.description: A stylized dream-eating tapir spirit in ukiyo-e woodblock style: an indigo barrel-bodied tapir with a short drooping trunk, a gold crescent moon on its brow, a flowing smoke mane down its spine, and pale dream wisps curling up into its nostrils.
spec.layout: Model space: +Y up, faces +Z, left is +X, feet on y = 0. From front (+Z) to back (-Z): the dream wisps (a pale smoke spiral and floating cloud puffs with gold stars and a glowing gold crescent moon, z 1.6 to 2.6, y 1.2 to 2.0) drift just ahead of the trunk tip. The head (z 1.05 to 2.0) is a chunky tapir skull at y 1.6 to 2.2: short trunk drooping forward-down to a flared nostril tip at [0, 1.42, 1.9], slightly open lower jaw with two small bone tusks, large gold-irised eyes on the skull sides, big dish ears tipped up to y 2.15, and a gold crescent moon emblem on the forehead. The body (z -1.45 to 1.2) is a wide barrel tapering gently at both ends, belly underside at y ~0.5, back crest at y ~1.6, with the neck rising from [0, 1.32, 0.72] to the head mount at [0, 1.66, 1.12]. Four short columnar legs (x = ±0.45, front pair centred at z 0.78, hind pair at z -0.72, gold hooves resting on y = 0) hold it square and calm in a rest pose. A smoke mane crest runs along the dorsal line from the forehead over the neck and back (mount maneSpine) into a thin ox-like tail dropping to [0, 0.62, -1.78], ending in a pale tuft tied with a gold band (z to -1.9). The ukiyo-e style shows everywhere as hard flat colour fields split by ink zig-zag edges (toon kit furEdge), gold wave-and-cloud emblems seated on shoulder and haunch, a small vermilion artist's-seal rectangle on the left flank, and low-poly faceted primitives throughout; the moon and stars glow softly (glow kit).

parts.builds: The barrel torso and neck. Sweep or loft one smooth low-poly body along catmull([0,1.15,-1.25],[0,1.05,-0.6],[0,1.05,0.2],[0,1.18,0.8],[0,1.32,0.72]) riding joints body and neck, with elliptical sections wider than tall: rx ~0.62 / ry ~0.55 through the mid and hips, 0.58 at the chest, 0.5 at the rump, rounding into the neck which continues as a tapering tube (radius 0.34 to 0.27) up to mount headRoot at [0,1.66,1.12] so the head part's skull overlaps it with no gap. The coat is a paint: toon-kit cel over furEdge with indigo above and cream below, split by a hard zig-zag edge inked in ink that runs around the flank at about n.y = -0.1 (belly, chin and leg-roots cream; back, sides and neck indigo), plus a broad indigoLight drift of stylized woodblock tone patches across the upper flank (paint with noise or patches, size ~0.3, same seed shared with nothing else). Add a small vermilion rectangular artist's-seal slab (like a woodblock stamp, ~0.07 x 0.1, ink-outlined) seated flat on the left flank near [0.55, 1.15, 0.1]. Seat one gold wave-cloud emblem per side: a flat extruded spiral-cloud medallion (~0.18 across, gold with goldPale inner line and ink rim) on the shoulder at mount shoulderL/shoulderR pushed to the surface, and a larger matching one on each haunch near [±0.55, 1.2, -0.85]. Along the dorsal line leave the crest skin clean between neck and tailRoot for the mane part, which sits on mount maneSpine. Nothing else on the torso.
parts.attaches: Neck tube ends at mount headRoot where the head part's skull begins; neck tube starts at mount neckRoot rising out of the chest sweep. Leg roots emerge from the barrel surface at mounts shoulderL/shoulderR/hipL/hipR (the legs part builds those limbs). Tail root and dorsal mane sit on the rump and spine at mounts tailRoot and maneSpine.

parts.builds: The whole head: skull, face, trunk, jaw, ears, eyes and brow emblem, riding joints head, jaw, trunkA, trunkB, trunkTip, earL, earR. Skull: a chunky rounded mass centred on mount headRoot, built from a scaled sphere or short loft (about 0.44 wide, 0.42 tall, 0.5 long, indigo on top, cream face below via the same furEdge family of paint or layered parts), tapering into a short blunt muzzle whose nose bridge ends at [0, 1.62, 1.5]. The trunk is the signature feature: sweep a chain through trunkA [0,1.64,1.48], trunkB [0,1.6,1.7] and trunkTip [0,1.42,1.88], radius 0.15 tapering to 0.07, cream on the underside and indigo on top with ink ridges as 4 or 5 thin dark rings (thin swept bands or stick rings) down its length; the tip flares into a soft tulip lip: a slightly wider disc with two small dark ink nostril discs facing forward-down, and a pair of cream lip curls. The mane is the model's signature flowing feature: along the dorsal line from the forehead [0,2.0,1.15] over mount maneSpine [0,1.56,0] to mount tailRoot [0,1.32,-1.32], build two staggered rows of flame-like smoke blades sweeping up and back, each a thin swept spike or small membrane blade (height 0.16 to 0.28, root radius 0.03 to 0.015) coloured root-to-tip from indigoDeep through mist and mistWhite to goldPale tips, roughly 20 to 26 blades total, leaning backward 20 to 40 degrees so the crest streams behind; a few longer wisps (3 or 4, height 0.4) at the neck and rump carry the silhouette. parts.builds: The dream being eaten, riding joints trunkA, trunkB, trunkTip and head. From the trunk tip [0,1.42,1.9] a spiral of pale smoke is drawn inward: sweep a spiral path (2 turns, pitch ~0.08, radius growing 0.05 to 0.12) that ends at the nostril tip, tube radius 0.035 to 0.012, colour mistDeep at the outer end blending to mistWhite at the mouth of the trunk. Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: baku, the dream-eating tapir spirit.
Style: ukiyo-e woodblock print.

spec.name: Baku, Dream-Eating Spirit
spec.description: A tapir-bodied baku with a drooping trunk, ivory tusks, tiger paws, an ox tail and a flame mane. It is built as a stylized ukiyo-e woodblock print: flat indigo, vermilion, cream and ochre, inked contours, scalloped wave bands and layered colour blades.
spec.layout:
The baku stands in a calm, symmetric rest pose, facing +Z, centred on x=0, with all four paws flat on y=0.

SILHOUETTE. A pear-shaped tapir barrel is highest at the rump (back top y~1.43) and slightly lower at the withers (y~1.33). The belly is at y~0.55 and the barrel is about 0.85 m wide. Four sturdy legs ~0.55 m long carry it. A short thick neck rises forward and up to a big wedge-shaped head at y~1.4. The head has an elephant-like proboscis that starts at z~1.5 and hangs forward and then down, ending near z=1.85, y=0.85, with a tiny upward curl at the tip. Two short ivory tusks flank the trunk root. A crest of curling flame-blades runs from between the ears along the neck to the withers. The ox tail leaves the rump at z~-0.98 and sweeps back and up in an S, ending in a flame tuft at about z=-1.6.

PROPORTIONS (push them). The head is large and characterful, with big round rhino/ox eyes. The paws are chunky tiger paws. The mane is bold and tall (to y~1.8). The ears are round.

FRONT TO BACK. Trunk tip (z 1.85), then tusks, face and eyes (z 1.3-1.6), ears and forehead sun-disc (z 1.1-1.35), neck with rope collar (z 0.85-1.15), shoulders and front legs (z~0.55), cream saddle (z 0.3 to -0.4), haunches and hind legs (z~-0.6), rump, tail root (z -0.98), tail tuft (z -1.6).

UKIYO-E LOOK ON EVERY PART.
- Flat colour only. Colour comes in stepped bands, never smooth: a root-to-tip bokashi simulated as 3-4 hard bands (indigoDeep, indigo, indigoLight, skyPale, or vermilionDeep, vermilion, coral, cream).
- A woodblock key-line is made of thin ink (#ink) sweeps of 5-9 mm radius with round caps. They run along silhouette edges: spine line, belly line, leg fronts, ear rims, jaw line, trunk edge. Every flame-blade, ear, tusk and toe is outlined by a slightly larger ink extrude seated just behind it.
- Hairline fur strokes are tiny ink spikes laid in flowing rows. Small gold dots and vermilion tomoe or spiral roundels (karakusa-style curls) sit on shoulders and haunches.
- The saddle's scalloped wave edges (seigaiha half-discs in cream, skyPale and ink) and kasumi mist bands are the print motifs.
- Keep primitives blocky and faceted: 6-10 sides on tubes, few segments on spheres.

TAIL. A tapering sweep through tail1-tail4 from tailRoot (r 0.07) down to r 0.03. It leaves backward and droops, then swoops up in an S so that it ends near tailTip with the tuft held at y~1.0-1.1. It is indigo with an ink key-line. A gold cuff ring with a vermilion band sits at the root, and 3 skyPale ring bands are spaced along the middle.

TUFT. At the tail end, a fan of 9-11 overlapping flame-blades (extrudes, 0.2-0.3 m long) curl up and back in a spray, each stacked in root-to-tip bokashi bands (vermilionDeep, vermilion, coral, cream), with ink outline layers behind. In the centre sits a larger curling tongue of indigoLight and skyPale. Two small spiral curls frame it.

RUMP CREST. 5 small flame-blades (same style as the mane, 0.12-0.2 m) sit along the rump top near rumpTop and run to the tail root. They are indigoDeep to indigo to skyPale with ink outlines.

KASUMI MIST. Two thin wave-edged kasumi mist bands (extrudes in skyPale and paperWhite with ink outline), draped low across each rear haunch edge where the saddle meets the haunch. Keep them thin, flat to the body, and just a few mm off the surface.

Colours: indigo, indigoDeep, indigoLight, skyPale, cream, paperWhite, vermilion, vermilionDeep, coral, gold, ink.
parts.attaches: The tail root is at tailRoot on the back of the torso and rides tail1-tail4 (parent hips). The rump crest sits on the torso's top at rumpTop and continues toward tailRoot. The mist bands lie on the surface of the haunch.

Category: Fantastical creature.

spec.name: Baku, the Dream-Eating Tapir Spirit
spec.description: A Malayan-tapir-bodied baku with an elephant trunk, a fierce gold-eyed face, a tiger-pawed stance and an ox tail, drawn as an ukiyo-e woodblock print: indigo and cream saddle, seigaiha waves, vermilion and gold flame mane, and a dream-cloud wisp drifting into its trunk.
spec.layout: Side-on quadruped facing +Z, centred on x=0. Body: a heavy barrel torso (belly at y~0.62, back at y~1.4) from the haunches at z=-1.1 to the chest at z=0.95. Tapir colouring as a woodblock print: indigo head, neck, shoulders, forelegs, hindquarters, hindlegs and tail; a creamy saddle band over back, flanks and belly from z=+0.35 back to z=-0.5. The saddle edge is a scalloped line. A sumi-black outline stroke runs along the spine and the saddle edge. The saddle carries seigaiha (overlapping concentric wave arcs) in pale blue and indigo as small flat parts seated on the surface. The neck rises from z=0.8 into a long wedge head with a domed forehead. Tiny fierce rhino-style eyes have gold irises, sumi pupils and vermilion brows. Vermilion kabuki-style cheek lines and a tomoe mark sit on the forehead. Round ears have cream rims and tips. Short ivory tusks flank the trunk root. The trunk droops forward and down to a tip at y~0.9, z~1.8, with cream wrinkle rings and pink nostrils. A dream-cloud wisp (sumi-outlined lilac and grey-blue scrolls, a small glowing moon, tiny stars) curls into the trunk tip. Four sturdy legs end in tiger paws with ivory claws, vermilion cuff bands and cream fur tufts; the paws rest on y=0. A crest of overlapping flame-shaped blades runs from the nape along the back to the rump, shaded vermilion, then gold, then cream at the tips, with sumi edges. Kumo (cloud scroll) roundels in vermilion and gold sit on shoulders and haunches. The ox tail curls up in an S and ends in a flame tuft in the same palette. Style on every part: flat colours only, bold sumi outlines as thin dark sweeps and rims, hard colour bands (bokashi done as 2-3 stepped tones), no smooth gradients, chunky simplified shapes. Facets stay low-poly. Left is +X.

parts.builds: The torso, one smooth loft on the pelvis/spine1/chest bones, from the rump at z=-1.1 to the chest at z=0.95. Half-width ~0.45, belly at y~0.62, back at y~1.4, with a high rounded rump and a deep chest. Tapir colouring through bands and sectors: indigo at the chest and shoulders (z>0.35) and the hindquarters (z<-0.5), cream saddle between over back, flanks and belly. The saddle edges are scalloped by rows of small indigo and cream wedge or disc parts seated on the surface (a woodblock zig-zag), not smooth lines. Seigaiha wave motif on the saddle flanks: rows of stacked small flat discs (cream, waveBlue, indigo, cream, shrinking) overlapped in a scale pattern, about 3 rows by 6 on each flank, plus a few on the back. A thin sumi stroke (thin sweep along the surface) edges the saddle front and rear and runs down the spine. Belly shadow band in indigoLight under the cream. A vermilion sash or belly cord with a gold knot and two ivory tassel strands hangs on the left flank of the saddle (a Shinto-spirit rope), a small gold bell at the knot. Rump: two sumi swirl lines on each haunch, hip bone bumps in indigoLight. Everything is flat-coloured with sumi outlines on the main silhouette edges.
parts.attaches: Neck tube starts at neckBase on the chest's front top. Legs hang from shoulderL/R and hipL/R (the leg tops sit inside the torso). The crest and tail start on the back at napeCrest..backCrestEnd and tailRoot at the rump.

parts.builds: Neck and head. A thick indigo neck sweep on neck1/neck2 from neckBase to headBase (radius ~0.2 tapering to 0.17), with a cream chest-bib scallop line and a sumi outline. Skull: a long wedge head, domed forehead, tapering muzzle toward trunkRoot (z up to 1.52), half-width ~0.18, indigo with an indigoLight highlight on the brow. Separate lower jaw on the jaw joint (indigo, cream chin), with an open-able mouth line in sumi, a beniPink tongue and small ivory teeth seated at the lip line. Rhino-style small, fierce eyes at about (±0.16, 1.42, 1.3): sumi almond outline, gold iris disc, black slit pupil, white glint dot; vermilion angled brow bars above each eye with a sumi underline. Kabuki-style kumadori cheek lines in vermilion (three sweeping lines per cheek), a vermilion tomoe (comma-swirl, built from two small spiral sweeps and a disc) on the forehead with a gold ring. Two short curved ivory tusks at the trunk root (±0.09, 1.2, 1.5) pointing down and forward. Round ears on earL/earR: indigo discs, cream rims, beniPink inner discs, cream tips, with a sumi outline ring, tilted outward and back. Long whisker strands (thin sumi sweeps) at the muzzle sides, and a few sumi hair strokes on the cheeks and forehead. Everything is flat-coloured, with bold outlines, no gradients.
parts.attaches: The neck starts at neckBase on the body chest. The trunk part begins at trunkRoot (z~1.5) at the muzzle front, so leave the front face of the muzzle open there. The mane crest starts at napeCrest behind the skull.

parts.builds: The elephant-like trunk and the dream it eats. The trunk is a tapering smooth sweep on trunk1..trunk3 from trunkRoot (radius ~0.11) drooping forward and down to trunkTip (radius ~0.065), indigo on top and cream-grey underneath (sectors), with 7-8 thin cream wrinkle rings (ring or along parts), a sumi outline stroke along the top, and a vermilion lip ridge on the upper trunk near the root. The tip is slightly flared, with two sumi nostril holes ringed in beniPink and a small finger-like lip. The dream: a wisp rolling in from the front side of the tip and drawn into the nostrils, built as 3-4 layered kumo cloud scrolls (spiral sweeps and stacked disc clusters), cloudGrey and dreamLilac with paper highlights and sumi outlines, each cloud a flat-coloured bundle of round puffs; a small glowing moonGlow moon (sphere with a sumi crescent shadow disc) and 4-6 tiny starWhite glowing stars (use the glow kit) sit inside the cloud. A thin dream-thread ribbon (a sweep in dreamLilac) spirals from the cloud into the nostril. The wisp stays beside and in front of the trunk tip and never covers the face.
parts.attaches: Root meets the muzzle at trunkRoot. The dream ribbon ends at trunkTip / dreamMouth.

parts.builds: Four legs, each a smooth sweep on its own leg chain (front: shoulderFL/FR to elbow, wrist, paw; hind: hipHL/HR to knee, hock, paw). They start with a muscular thigh or upper-arm mass inside the torso (radius ~0.16 at the top, ~0.09 at the wrist), the hind legs with a slight backward hock bend. All indigo, with an indigoLight highlight sector down the front and a sumi outline stroke on the rear edge. Tiger paws: wide round indigo paw pads with 4 toe bumps each, ivory claws (small cones) pointing forward and slightly down, a thick cream fur cuff above each paw made of 5-6 small overlapping wedge tufts, plus a vermilion cuff band with a gold bead trim above it. A little wave motif (3 pale-blue arcs) on the outer side of each upper leg. Sumi paw pad lines. The paws rest flat on y=0 (lowest points at y≈0, sinking at most 0.02), with a front/hind pair at the same stance. Elbow and knee joints are marked by small indigoLight cap discs with a sumi ring. Everything stays chunky and simple, with flat colours.
parts.attaches: The leg tops sit inside the body torso at shoulderL/R and hipL/R. The legs ride the chest and pelvis chains.

parts.builds: The flame mane and the ox tail. Mane: a crest of broad, overlapping flame/wave-crest blades (extrudes, 2-3 rows) running from napeCrest over the neck and withers and along the spine to backCrestEnd, tallest (up to y~1.8) at the withers, shrinking toward the rump. The blades curl forward and up like Hokusai wave crests, ending in small curl hooks (spiral sweeps). The root-to-tip palette is stepped as hard bands, vermilionDark root, then vermilion, then gold, then cream tip, with a thin sumi outline plate under each blade and a base ridge of dark indigo. Shoulder and haunch kumo roundels: on each shoulder (±0.46, 1.1, 0.55) and each haunch (±0.46, 1.05, -0.72), a flat spiral cloud scroll (spiral sweeps with a gold disc centre and a vermilion ring, sumi outline) seated on the side of the body surface. Ox tail: a tapering indigo sweep on tail1..tail3 from tailRoot in an S that curls up to tailTip, with a sumi outline stroke, ending in a tuft of 7-9 flame blades fanned out (vermilion, gold, cream bands as in the mane) with 2-3 small curls. A few detached flame wisps (small flames) are rooted on the mane and tail only; nothing floats away from the body.
parts.attaches: The crest roots on the body's back line between napeCrest and backCrestEnd, behind the head box. Roundels sit on the body flanks at the shoulderL/R and hipL/R heights. The tail roots at tailRoot on the rump.

The head is a near-sphere riding high and forward on a short neck, crested with one yellow triangle feather. Legs are slim black bars from body to the perch, ending in three-toed feet gripped around the branch top at the perchTop mount. Every surface is a flat colour from the palette; details — eye rings, beak halves, wing bars, tail stripes, branch bark bands and leaf sprigs (yellow circle + blue triangle + red disc) — are small separate parts seated on the surface, with black trim outlining the signature shapes. parts.builds: The head, the model's signature piece, riding the head joint aimed up-and-forward: a near-sphere about 0.11 m across in 'blue', its lower half dipping into the red chest so the two meet in a clean seam. parts.attaches: Sits on the head joint at [0, 0.72, 0.09]; its rear lower edge meets the birdTorso neck seam at z ≈ 0.1; the beak tip is the model's forward-most point at z ≈ 0.34.

parts.builds: The legs and gripping feet: from each leg joint, a slim black bar leg (thin rod or capsule, r ≈ 0.008) dropping about 0.07 m from the body's underside to the branch top at perchTop. The bird stands at the branch centre facing the viewer (+Z), centred on x=0. From front to back: a yellow conical beak at z≈0.13..0.21; a round black-capped head at [0, 0.44, 0.07] with cream cheek discs and big side-set ring eyes; a short blue egg body from y≈0.22 to 0.38 leaning slightly forward, with a bold red breast disc on the chest front, cream belly below and folded blue wing slabs on each flank; black fanned tail feathers rising up-back to about [0, 0.40, -0.26]; two slate legs dropping from the body underside to the branch top with black toes gripping the bark. A forked twig rises from the branch near x=0.26 up to y≈0.30 carrying flat circular leaf discs in yellow, red and blue plus two red berries; the branch wears cream painted ring bands and a growth-ring cut face. Every part is flat-coloured Bauhaus geometry: bold circles, discs and egg/cone primitives in red, blue, yellow, cream and ink on charcoal, with trim as small seated parts (eye rings, wingbar, painted branch rings, leg bands).

spec.name: Bauhaus Songbird on a Branch
spec.description: A stylized songbird assembled from pure circles, half-circles, triangles and bars in hard red, yellow, blue, black and cream, perched on a felled branch resting on the floor.
spec.layout: Model space: +Y up, bird faces +Z, centred on x=0. The ground line is a straight felled branch of radius about 0.085 lying along Z from z=-0.95 to z=+0.88, centre line at y=0.09, so its lowest points touch y=0; its front end (z=+0.88) is a flat cut face showing concentric growth-ring discs, its rear end is a rough broken taper, and a knobbly side twig rises from the branch's left-rear (+X side) at z=-0.35 up to y about 0.46, carrying three flat geometric leaves (a blue circle, a yellow half-disc, a red triangle) and small yellow bud spheres. The bird perches on top of the branch at z=+0.05, feet gripping the branch top at y=0.175: an egg-shaped blue torso (centre about [0, 0.42, 0.04], about 0.14 x 0.185 x 0.17, chest tilted slightly forward) with a bold red half-disc breast plate on its front, a cream lower belly bulge, and a black rump band; a round black head (r about 0.095) at [0, 0.66, 0.17] with a cream cheek patch, large side eyes (white ring, black pupil, both visible from the front), a yellow triangular beak pointing forward-down to z about 0.34, and a tiny blue crest wedge; folded black wings as flat slabs hugging each flank from the shoulders (x about plus/minus 0.13, y 0.53) down-back to pointed tips near [x, 0.34, -0.30], each wearing a white bar and a yellow bar near the trailing edge with three stepped primary tips; a fan tail of five flat feather slabs sloping down-back from the rump at [0, 0.45, -0.10] to z about -0.55, blue with a black base band and yellow tips; thin black legs from the belly down to the perch with three forward toes and one rear toe wrapping the branch. The Bauhaus style shows everywhere: every piece is a pure primitive silhouette (spheres, cones, cylinders, extruded circles, half-discs and triangles), every colour a hard flat fill, seams and outlines are thin black parts seated on the surface, and the primaries red-yellow-blue carry the bird while wood browns stay quiet beneath it.

parts.builds: The felled branch and everything on it. Main log: a tapered cylinder (radius 0.095 at the rear end down to 0.075 at the front) along Z from z=-0.95 to z=+0.88, axis at y=0.09 so the bark rests on the floor; wood colour, flat-shaded. Front cut face: a flat disc of woodCut closing the tube at z=+0.88 facing +Z, with two thinner concentric discs stepped slightly forward (woodDark inner, woodCut again, radii about 0.05 and 0.03) reading as growth rings, plus a tiny black centre dot. Rear end tapers to a rough broken stub with a woodDark cap. Two knuckle bulges (slightly flattened woodDark spheres, r about 0.05) embedded in the bark at z=-0.6 and z=+0.4, and 6 small cream lichen dots (flattened spheres r 0.015-0.025) scattered on the upper surface between z=-0.8 and z=+0.7, avoiding the perch point at z=+0.05. Side twig: a rod of radius 0.03 from [0.10, 0.11, -0.35] rising to [0.22, 0.46, -0.30] with a short sub-twig forking to [0.30, 0.40, -0.20], woodDark; on its tips three flat geometric leaves as thin extruded shapes (thickness about 0.012): a blue circle-leaf (r 0.07), a yellow half-disc-leaf (r 0.08, flat edge toward the twig), and a red triangle-leaf (about 0.12 tall), each tilted at a different angle, plus 5 small yellow bud spheres (r 0.018) dotted along the twig. All branch geometry rides the root joint; the twig tips stay under y=0.55 and x under 0.32.
parts.attaches: Rests on the floor by itself (floor: true). The bird's feet land on its top surface at mount perchTop [0, 0.175, 0.05]; leave that spot clear of lichen and knuckles.

parts.builds: The bird's egg body. A blue sphere scaled to an egg (about 0.14 x 0.185 x 0.17 radii) centred at [0, 0.42, 0.04], tilted so the chest sits low at the front (z about +0.19, y about 0.34) and the rump high at the back (z about -0.11, y about 0.50). Breast: a bold red half-disc (extruded half-circle, thickness about 0.035, flat edge down) seated on the front of the chest at about [0, 0.40, 0.165], radius 0.10, arc on top, facing +Z so it reads as a robin-like bib from the front. Lower belly: a cream sphere (r about 0.115) at [0, 0.33, 0.06] bulging out under the chest between the legs. Rump: a thin black band (a short tube or torus segment) round the rear of the egg at about [0, 0.46, -0.09] where it meets the tail mount. Shoulder line: two small blue dome caps (r 0.05) at the wing mounts [plus/minus 0.13, 0.53, 0.08] so the wings seat into the body. A few black seam dots (r 0.008) in a row along the top of the back for rhythm. Torso rides the body joint; keep the belly bottom above y=0.26 since the legs bridge the gap to the branch.
parts.attaches: Feet land on the branch at mount perchTop via the legs part; rear meets the tail at mount tailRoot [0, 0.45, -0.10]; top meets the head at mount neckBase [0, 0.56, 0.12]; wings bolt onto the shoulders at wingShoulderL and wingShoulderR.

parts.builds: The round black head and its face. Skull: a black sphere r 0.095 centred at [0, 0.66, 0.17], tilted slightly forward. Cheek patch: a cream flat disc (extruded circle, thickness 0.015, radius 0.055) seated on each side of the head below and behind the eye at about [plus/minus 0.075, 0.63, 0.15], facing outward. Eyes: on each side at [plus/minus 0.082, 0.68, 0.20] a white sphere (r 0.028) with a black pupil sphere (r 0.015) seated forward on it; both eyes placed far enough forward that they read from the front. Brow accents: two tiny yellow wedge bars above each eye. Beak: a yellow cone (base radius 0.032, length 0.10) from the beak base at [0, 0.64, 0.245] pointing forward and slightly down to a tip at about [0, 0.625, 0.34]; a thin black seam rod (r 0.004) runs along the mouth line from base to tip splitting upper and lower mandible, and the lower mandible is a separate thinner yellow cone (base r 0.024, length 0.08) under the seam so the jaw can open, riding the jaw joint. Crest: one small blue triangle wedge (extruded, about 0.05 tall) standing on the crown at [0, 0.75, 0.14], leaning back. All head geometry rides the head joint except the lower mandible on the jaw joint.
parts.attaches: Sits on the torso at mount neckBase [0, 0.56, 0.12]; the skull's underside overlaps the torso's top so there is no gap.

parts.builds: Both folded wings, mirrored left and right. Each wing is a flat teardrop slab (extruded leaf shape, thickness about 0.035, smoothing 2) rooted at its shoulder mount [plus/minus 0.13, 0.53, 0.08] and laid flat against the flank, sweeping down and back to a pointed tip near [plus/minus 0.10, 0.34, -0.30], black. On each wing near the trailing edge: a cream/white bar (thin extruded strip crossing the wing, about 0.02 thick, seated just proud of the black surface) and a yellow bar below it near the tip, so two hard colour stripes band the folded wing. At the tip, three stepped primary feather slabs (thin flat quads, about 0.09 long, thickness 0.015, staggered 0.02 apart) in blueDark poking past the black tip in a staircase, echoing the Bauhaus rhythm. A thin blue-dark edge line (thin rod or strip) traces the wing's leading edge from shoulder to wrist. Both wings ride the body joint rigidly; keep them inside x = plus/minus 0.26 and clear of the tail slabs.
parts.attaches: Rooted on the torso's shoulders at mount wingShoulderL [0.13, 0.53, 0.08] and wingShoulderR [-0.13, 0.53, 0.08], with the wing root buried slightly into the torso egg so no gap shows; tips reach back over the tail root without touching the tail slabs.

parts.builds: The fanned tail: five flat feather slabs (thin extruded shapes, thickness about 0.016) fanning from the mount tailRoot [0, 0.45, -0.10] down and back to tips around z about -0.52 to -0.58, y about 0.28-0.32; the centre slab is longest, the outer two shorter and angled about 12-18 degrees each side, so the fan reads as a clean triangle silhouette. Each feather is blue with a black band (a thin black slab across the feather's base third) and a yellow tip band (a thin slab across the last 15% of its length); the underside-facing edges can take cream tips on the two outermost feathers. A small black wedge (the rump coverts) caps the fan's root where it meets the torso's rump band. All tail geometry rides the tail joint.
parts.attaches: Rooted into the torso at mount tailRoot [0, 0.45, -0.10], passing just under the wing tips; stays clear of the branch surface (its lowest point around y=0.24, above the branch top of y about 0.175).

parts.builds: The legs and feet that grip the perch. Each leg: a thin black cylinder (r 0.012) from the belly at [plus/minus 0.05, 0.30, 0.05] straight down to the branch top at [plus/minus 0.05, 0.185, 0.05], landing exactly on mount perchTop, with a tiny yellow ring band (thin torus, r 0.014) as an anklet just above the foot. Each foot: three forward toes as short bent rods (r 0.008, about 0.05 long each) spreading at about -35, 0 and +35 degrees around the front of the branch and curling down its sides to about y=0.10, plus one rear toe rod curling back around the branch's underside at z about 0.0, all black with tiny cream claw tips (small cones, 0.012 long). The toes visibly wrap the branch so the grip reads from the front. Leg geometry rides the legL and legR joints; toes ride their own leg's joint.
parts.attaches: Feet land on the branch's top at mount perchTop [0, 0.175, 0.05]; thighs emerge from the torso's cream belly at about y=0.30, buried slightly into the egg so no gap shows.

spec.name: Bauhaus Songbird
spec.description: A small perching songbird assembled from primitive geometry in Bauhaus primary colours (red sphere body, blue head, yellow triangle beak and wings), sitting on a black geometric branch with a block trunk.
spec.layout: Real songbird scale: about 0.30 m from beak tip (z +0.118) to tail tip (z -0.18), head top at y 0.425. The branch is a horizontal black limb along X (x -0.30..0.30, axis y 0.20, radius 0.02, top y 0.22, z 0) with a square trunk post at x -0.24 standing on a flat base plate on y = 0. The bird perches centred at x 0, faces +Z, perpendicular to the branch. From front to back: small yellow beak, a round blue head sphere, a red egg-shaped body, a cream round belly disc on the chest, yellow triangular wings folded along the flanks, and a long flat blue tail slanting down and back with red and yellow bars. Two thin black legs (tarsus) drop from the body and the toes grip the branch top (3 front toes, 1 back toe, each resting at y about 0.224-0.23). Bauhaus language: every form is a pure primitive (sphere, 3-4 sided cone, box, disc, triangle extrude) with hard flat colour. Primary red, yellow, blue plus black and cream. Facets stay visible (low segment counts, 6-10 around). The composition repeats circle / triangle / square: circle = body, head, eyes, cheek discs; triangle = beak, wings, tail tip, branch leaves; square = trunk, base, tail bars. Details (eye rings, wing bars, belly disc, feather stripes) are small separate parts in their own colours seated on the surfaces.

parts.builds: The branch and its stand, all on joint root. A flat square base plate (cream, about 0.12 x 0.012 x 0.12 at x -0.24) on the floor; a square trunk post (black, 0.04 x 0.04, y 0.012..0.2) at x -0.24; the main horizontal branch as an 8-sided black rod/sweep from x -0.30 to x 0.30 along y 0.20, z 0, radius 0.02 (top at y 0.22, so the bird's feet rest on it), with a slight taper to 0.015 at the +x end. Bauhaus decoration: three cream ring bands (thin discs/rods) around the branch at x -0.15, 0.15, 0.24 (not under the bird, clear of |x| < 0.06); a red flat disc and a yellow triangle extrude as leaf motifs on short charcoal twig rods at the +x end and near the trunk, rising no higher than y 0.30 and staying at |x| > 0.12; a blue small cube knot on the trunk; a yellow cap triangle or disc on the branch's cut end at x 0.30 and a red disc on the -x end. No bird anatomy. Nothing at |x| < 0.06 above y 0.225.
parts.attaches: Branch top at perchTop (y 0.22) carries the feet at footL/footR. Stand on floorOrigin.

parts.builds: Body and tail. Red egg-shaped body: sphere scaled to radii x 0.045, y 0.048, z 0.065 at bodyCenter (about 10 x 7 segments, faceted), on joint body. Cream round belly disc/half-sphere seated on the front-lower chest around bellyFront (radius ~0.032, flattened), plus a thin yellow ring disc around it. Blue back saddle: a flattened blue cap over the upper back (a squashed sphere or lathe cap hugging the body top, y up to 0.353), with 3 small yellow triangle chevrons or discs on it as Bauhaus pattern. A small redDeep rump wedge near tailRoot. Tail: a long flat blue tail built as a few overlapping flat boxes/extruded rectangles fanned slightly (centre feather plus two side feathers, thickness 0.004, width about 0.03 total, length from tailRoot to tailTip z -0.18, slanting down to y 0.25) riding tail1/tail2; red and yellow square bar stripes across it (thin boxes in their own colour, seated on top), a yellow triangle tip. Navy undertail coverts block below tail root. The body stays clear of the head sphere (neck mount at neckBase) and leaves room for wings on the flanks (x +-0.043..0.06) and legs at hipL/hipR.
parts.attaches: Neck at neckBase, wings at shoulderL/shoulderR, legs at hipL/hipR, tail begins at tailRoot (joint tail1). Everything else rides body / tail1 / tail2.

parts.builds: Neck, head and beak, the face settled first. Blue head sphere radius 0.036 centred at headCenter (about 10 x 8 segments) on joint head, with a short blue neck collar cylinder/sphere linking neckBase to the head on joint neck. Eyes: on each side at about x +-0.027, y 0.395, z 0.07, a white disc (radius 0.0095), black ring behind, a black pupil disc (0.0055) in front and a tiny white highlight; discs face outward-forward and sit proud of the head sphere surface by about 1 mm. Red round cheek disc (radius 0.012) below and behind each eye. Yellow triangle brow wedge or crown: a small yellow extruded triangle on top of the head (crest) plus a thin black stripe across the crown. Beak: upper beak a yellow 4-sided cone (radius 0.014 base at beakBase, tip at beakTip, slightly flattened vertically) on joint head; lower beak a smaller, shorter yellowPale 4-sided cone below it on joint jaw (hinge jawHinge), a thin gap/black mouth line (thin dark box) between them. Two tiny black nostril dots on the upper beak. Nothing in front of the face. Cream chin/throat disc under the beak on the head.
parts.attaches: Neck base meets the torso at neckBase; head sphere centre headCenter; jaw hinges at jawHinge; beak starts at beakBase and ends at beakTip.

parts.builds: Left and right wings (mirror with +x = left), folded against the flanks but slightly separate from the body. Each wing: a yellow main triangular extruded slab (thickness about 0.008, shoulder at shoulderL/R, broad at the front, pointing back to a tip near z -0.13, y about 0.27, x about +-0.058) on joint wingL/wingR, following the flank so its inner face sits at x about +-0.044..0.05 (just outside the body's side at those heights). Layered Bauhaus feather shapes on the outside face: a smaller blue triangle covert layer near the shoulder, a red disc/half-disc spot, 3 long thin primary strips (navy, blue, red) stacked towards the tip riding wingL2/wingR2 with slightly fanned angles, a thin black outline strip along the leading edge, and a white small square bar. Each wing is a clear assembly of 8-14 pieces. Wings stay inside x +-0.07 and do not touch the tail attachments or head.
parts.attaches: Roots at shoulderL / shoulderR on the body flanks; tips trail towards tailRoot's side, beside the tail.

parts.builds: Both legs and feet. Each leg: a short feathered cream thigh tuft (small sphere/cone) at hipL/hipR just hiding the body underside, a thin black tarsus rod (radius 0.0035, 6 sides) from the hip down to the ankle at y 0.228 (x +-0.022), a small yellow ankle ball. Four toes per foot from the ankle: two front toes angled slightly apart forward (+z up to z +0.035) and one longer back toe (hallux) to z -0.022, each a thin black rod radius 0.003-0.004 with a small yellow claw tip (tiny cone) and a small black knuckle sphere; toes rest on the branch top, lying at y about 0.224-0.23 and curling down slightly at the ends, with bottoms touching but not deeper than y 0.221 (branch top 0.22). Left and right legs mirror in x.
parts.attaches: Hips at hipL/hipR under the body; feet at footL/footR on the perchTop.
